title: 感測器省略馬達估測
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討反電勢觀測器、低速可觀測性與估測融合，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore back-EMF observers, low-speed observability and estimator fusion, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。估測器適用性依電機、速度、飽和與訊號品質而異；未配置真實參考量測時不宣稱實機角度精度。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Estimator suitability depends on motor, speed, saturation and signals; do not claim real-machine angle accuracy without reference measurements.

stages.title: 模型與可觀測性
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成模型與可觀測性；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete models and observability through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 建立電壓模型：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Build voltage models: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解建立電壓模型，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand build voltage models through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 將 DC 電壓變動與占空比限制加入 v 模型，對比理想命令。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Add bus-voltage variation and duty limits to the voltage model and compare with ideal commands. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 將 DC 電壓變動與占空比限制加入 v 模型，對比理想命令。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Add bus-voltage variation and duty limits to the voltage model and compare with ideal commands. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 建立電壓模型：原理
knowledge.text: 估反電勢需要實際施加電壓，不只是控制器理想電壓命令。

knowledge.title: 建立電壓模型：證據

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：用 e=v−Ri−Ldi/dt 估反電勢，若真 e=1 V、電阻誤差 ΔR=0.05 Ω、電流 10 A，僅電阻誤差就造成 0.5 V 偏差。高速 e=20 V 時同偏差只占 2.5%，顯示低速更難。 估測器適用性依電機、速度、飽和與訊號品質而異；未配置真實參考量測時不宣稱實機角度精度。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: estimate e=v−Ri−Ldi/dt. If true e=1 V, resistance error ΔR=0.05 Ω at 10 A introduces 0.5 V bias. At high-speed e=20 V the same bias is only 2.5%, illustrating the low-speed difficulty. Estimator suitability depends on motor, speed, saturation and signals; do not claim real-machine angle accuracy without reference measurements.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：用 e=v−Ri−Ldi/dt 估反電勢，若真 e=1 V、電阻誤差 ΔR=0.05 Ω、電流 10 A，僅電阻誤差就造成 0.5 V 偏差。高速 e=20 V 時同偏差只占 2.5%，顯示低速更難。 估測器適用性依電機、速度、飽和與訊號品質而異；未配置真實參考量測時不宣稱實機角度精度。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: estimate e=v−Ri−Ldi/dt. If true e=1 V, resistance error ΔR=0.05 Ω at 10 A introduces 0.5 V bias. title: 再生煞車電力回收
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討機械動能、回生轉矩與儲能接受能力，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore kinetic energy, regenerative torque and storage acceptance, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。這是離線功率與控制課，不是道路車輛煞車改裝指南；制動安全與功能安全需獨立專業驗證。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. This is offline power/control education, not a road-vehicle braking modification guide; braking and functional safety need independent professional validation.

options: 只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
用 ΣJω²/2 對各軸分項，避免把高速軸直接當車輪轉速。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
Sum Jω²/2 by shaft rather than assign wheel speed to high-speed shafts.

quiz.explanationEn: Wheel/drivetrain rotational energy belongs in the ledger; equivalent mass needs gear-ratio justification. Sum Jω²/2 by shaft rather than assign wheel speed to high-speed shafts.

steps.title: 拆分坡度與阻力：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Separate grades and drag: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解拆分坡度與阻力，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand separate grades and drag through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 在同速度曲線加入重力位能項和阻力耗能，檢查守恆。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。

State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 在同速度曲線加入重力位能項和阻力耗能，檢查守恆。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Add gravitational potential and drag dissipation to one speed profile and check conservation. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「拆分坡度與阻力」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把機械動能、回生轉矩與儲能接受能力的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。

steps.check: 交付「拆分坡度與阻力」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。

knowledge.textEn: Clip one regenerative profile with three hypothetical BMS limits and calculate excess energy.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：1,500 kg 車輛由 20 m/s 降至 10 m/s，動能差 0.5m(v₁²−v₂²)=225 kJ=62.5 Wh；若機電回收效率 70%，最多回收 43.75 Wh，尚需扣除其他限制造成的損失。 這是離線功率與控制課，不是道路車輛煞車改裝指南；制動安全與功能安全需獨立專業驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 1,500 kg vehicle slowing from 20 to 10 m/s loses 0.5m(v₁²−v₂²)=225 kJ=62.5 Wh. At 70% recovery efficiency, at most 43.75 Wh is recovered before other limits. This is offline power/control education, not a road-vehicle braking modification guide; braking and functional safety need independent professional validation.

quiz.question: 關於「建構充電接受包絡：反證與驗收」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？

optionsEn: Clip one regenerative profile with three hypothetical BMS limits and calculate excess energy.
If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: 高 SOC、低溫和老化都可降低電池容許充電功率。 對三種假設 BMS 限值裁切回生功率序列，計算餘能。
quiz.explanationEn: High SOC, low temperature and aging can reduce acceptable charge power. Clip one regenerative profile with three hypothetical BMS limits and calculate excess energy.

steps.title: 分配混合儲能：建立模型

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解分配混合儲能，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand allocate hybrid storage through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 連續重複制動事件，檢查電容是否逐次充滿而失去緩衝。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。

steps.check: 交付「分配混合儲能」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。

steps.objectiveEn: Understand analyze backup support through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 建立概念失效樹，把控制電源、位置感測和支承能力分開。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Build a conceptual fault tree separating control power, sensing and backup support capacity. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 建立概念失效樹，把控制電源、位置感測和支承能力分開。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Build a conceptual fault tree separating control power, sensing and backup support capacity. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「分析備援支承」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把磁浮位置回授、負剛性、轉子模態與停機能量的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If analyze backup support disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of magnetic-bearing feedback, negative stiffness, rotor modes and rundown energy behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「分析備援支承」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for analyze backup support, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 分析備援支承：證據
knowledge.text: 建立概念失效樹，把控制電源、位置感測和支承能力分開。
knowledge.textEn: Build a conceptual fault tree separating control power, sensing and backup support capacity.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：簡化吸力 F≈kI²/g²，若電流固定而氣隙由 1.0 降至 0.8 mm，吸力增至 1/0.8²=1.5625 倍。轉子越靠近磁極吸力越強，顯示需主動穩定；此式忽略飽和和漏磁。 磁浮軸承屬高速轉子安全關鍵系統；只分析公開概念及合成數據，不指導超速、拆卸或實機增益調整。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: approximate attraction F≈kI²/g². At fixed current reducing gap from 1.0 to 0.8 mm raises force by 1/0.8²=1.5625. Attraction grows as the rotor approaches a pole, requiring active stabilization; saturation and leakage are omitted. Magnetic bearings are safety-critical high-speed rotor systems; only public concepts and synthetic data are analyzed, without overspeed, disassembly or live tuning instructions.

steps.title: 交付穩定性證據：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Deliver stability evidence: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解交付穩定性證據，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand deliver stability evidence through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 先沿用模型，寫下會推翻「性能須涵蓋轉速、溫度、偏置和感測誤差的範圍。」的觀察。製作工況矩陣，對每格記錄位移、電流、阻尼與尚未驗證模態。 加入一個對照條件，分開記錄原始數據、推論與不確定度；若前提失效則暫緩判定。
steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: Evidence must cover speed, temperature, bias and sensing-error ranges. Build a case matrix recording displacement, current, damping and unvalidated modes. Add a control condition and separate raw data, inference and uncertainty. Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.
steps.observation: 製作工況矩陣，對每格記錄位移、電流、阻尼與尚未驗證模態。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Build a case matrix recording displacement, current, damping and unvalidated modes. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「交付穩定性證據」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把磁浮位置回授、負剛性、轉子模態與停機能量的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If deliver stability evidence disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of magnetic-bearing feedback, negative stiffness, rotor modes and rundown energy behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「交付穩定性證據」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for deliver stability evidence, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：簡化吸力 F≈kI²/g²，若電流固定而氣隙由 1.0 降至 0.8 mm，吸力增至 1/0.8²=1.5625 倍。轉子越靠近磁極吸力越強，顯示需主動穩定；此式忽略飽和和漏磁。 磁浮軸承屬高速轉子安全關鍵系統；只分析公開概念及合成數據，不指導超速、拆卸或實機增益調整。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: approximate attraction F≈kI²/g². At fixed current reducing gap from 1.0 to 0.8 mm raises force by 1/0.8²=1.5625. Attraction grows as the rotor approaches a pole, requiring active stabilization; saturation and leakage are omitted. Magnetic bearings are safety-critical high-speed rotor systems; only public concepts and synthetic data are analyzed, without overspeed, disassembly or live tuning instructions.

title: 碳化矽牽引逆變器
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討SiC 開關暫態、牽引效率與電熱限制，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore SiC switching transients, traction efficiency and electrothermal limits, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。電動車高壓牽引系統需絕緣、功能安全與專業試驗；本課只操作合成波形和模型，不提供實機高壓接線。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. High-voltage traction requires insulation, functional safety and professional tests; this course uses synthetic traces/models without physical high-voltage wiring instructions.

stages.descriptionEn: Complete traction and devices through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 界定牽引工作區：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Bound traction operation: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解界定牽引工作區，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand bound traction operation through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 建立轉矩—轉速圖，加入電池電壓上下限兩種情境。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Build torque-speed maps for low/high battery voltage. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 建立轉矩—轉速圖，加入電池電壓上下限兩種情境。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Build torque-speed maps for low/high battery voltage. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「界定牽引工作區」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把SiC 開關暫態、牽引效率與電熱限制的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If bound traction operation disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of SiC switching transients, traction efficiency and electrothermal limits behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「界定牽引工作區」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for bound traction operation, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.text: 峰值功率、持續轉矩與回生能力須分開指定。
knowledge.textEn: Peak power, continuous torque and regeneration must be specified separately.

knowledge.title: 界定牽引工作區：證據
knowledge.text: 建立轉矩—轉速圖，加入電池電壓上下限兩種情境。
knowledge.textEn: Build torque-speed maps for low/high battery voltage.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：假設一次開關 Eon+Eoff=2 mJ、fs=20 kHz，單顆近似開關損耗 40 W。若導通 RMS 電流 100 A、等效 Rds(on)=5 mΩ，導通損耗 50 W；R 值必須對應工作溫度，開關能量也須對應電壓電流條件。 電動車高壓牽引系統需絕緣、功能安全與專業試驗；本課只操作合成波形和模型，不提供實機高壓接線。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: assumed Eon+Eoff=2 mJ at fs=20 kHz gives about 40 W switching loss per device. At 100 A RMS and effective Rds(on)=5 mΩ, conduction loss is 50 W. Resistance must match operating temperature and switching energy must match voltage/current conditions. High-voltage traction requires insulation, functional safety and professional tests; this course uses synthetic traces/models without physical high-voltage wiring instructions.

knowledge.textEn: Gate charge and output capacitance govern different energy paths and cannot substitute for all loss terms.

knowledge.title: 比較 Qg 與 Coss：證據
knowledge.text: 分別畫閘極驅動和功率換流能量帳，標出電壓相依。
knowledge.textEn: Draw separate gate-drive and power-commutation ledgers and mark voltage dependence.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：假設寄生迴路 L=5 nH、di/dt=2 A/ns，Ldi/dt 過衝為 10 V。若等效開關能量 20 μJ、頻率 500 kHz，平均開關損耗 10 W；這是教學假設，不是任何 GaN 料號規格。 不同 GaN 技術的門極電壓、反向行為和動態電阻不同；不能把矽 MOSFET 或某一 GaN 的設定直接套用。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: assumed loop L=5 nH and di/dt=2 A/ns produce 10 V overshoot from Ldi/dt. Effective switching energy 20 μJ at 500 kHz yields 10 W average switching loss. These are teaching assumptions, not GaN part specifications. Gate voltage, reverse behavior and dynamic resistance differ across GaN technologies; do not transfer silicon or one GaN device’s settings blindly.

quiz.question: 關於「比較 Qg 與 Coss：建立模型」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？
quiz.questionEn: For “Compare Qg and Coss: build the model”, which claim or verification is justified?
options: 只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
閘極電荷和輸出電容控制不同能量路徑，不可用一者代替全部損耗。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Gate charge and output capacitance govern different energy paths and cannot substitute for all loss terms.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: 閘極電荷和輸出電容控制不同能量路徑，不可用一者代替全部損耗。 分別畫閘極驅動和功率換流能量帳，標出電壓相依。
quiz.explanationEn: Gate charge and output capacitance govern different energy paths and cannot substitute for all loss terms. Draw separate gate-drive and power-commutation ledgers and mark voltage dependence.

steps.title: 比較 Qg 與 Coss：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Compare Qg and Coss: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解比較 Qg 與 Coss，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand compare qg and coss through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 先沿用模型，寫下會推翻「閘極電荷和輸出電容控制不同能量路徑，不可用一者代替全部損耗。」的觀察。分別畫閘極驅動和功率換流能量帳，標出電壓相依。 加入一個對照條件，分開記錄原始數據、推論與不確定度；若前提失效則暫緩判定。
steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: Gate charge and output capacitance govern different energy paths and cannot substitute for all loss terms. Draw separate gate-drive and power-commutation ledgers and mark voltage dependence. Add a control condition and separate raw data, inference and uncertainty. Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.
steps.observation: 分別畫閘極驅動和功率換流能量帳，標出電壓相依。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Draw separate gate-drive and power-commutation ledgers and mark voltage dependence. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「比較 Qg 與 Coss」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把GaN 寄生、反向導通與高頻量測限制的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If compare qg and coss disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of GaN parasitics, reverse conduction and high-frequency measurement limits behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「比較 Qg 與 Coss」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for compare qg and coss, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：假設寄生迴路 L=5 nH、di/dt=2 A/ns，Ldi/dt 過衝為 10 V。若等效開關能量 20 μJ、頻率 500 kHz，平均開關損耗 10 W；這是教學假設，不是任何 GaN 料號規格。 不同 GaN 技術的門極電壓、反向行為和動態電阻不同；不能把矽 MOSFET 或某一 GaN 的設定直接套用。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: assumed loop L=5 nH and di/dt=2 A/ns produce 10 V overshoot from Ldi/dt. Effective switching energy 20 μJ at 500 kHz yields 10 W average switching loss. Gate voltage, reverse behavior and dynamic resistance differ across GaN technologies; do not transfer silicon or one GaN device’s settings blindly.

knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: assumed loop L=5 nH and di/dt=2 A/ns produce 10 V overshoot from Ldi/dt. Effective switching energy 20 μJ at 500 kHz yields 10 W average switching loss. Gate voltage, reverse behavior and dynamic resistance differ across GaN technologies; do not transfer silicon or one GaN device’s settings blindly.

title: 諧振 LLC 電源設計
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討LLC 雙諧振、增益曲線與軟切換邊界，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore LLC dual resonances, gain curves and soft-switching bounds, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。基波近似用於初步理解，輕載、啟動與大偏離諧振時需時域模型；本課不提供高壓實機調機程序。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Fundamental-harmonic approximation is introductory; light load, startup and operation far from resonance need time-domain models, with no live high-voltage tuning instructions.

knowledge.title: 辨識三個儲能元件：原理
knowledge.text: Lr、Lm 與 Cr 的作用不同，磁化支路並非可任意刪除。
knowledge.textEn: Lr, Lm and Cr have distinct roles; the magnetizing branch cannot be arbitrarily removed.

knowledge.title: 辨識三個儲能元件：證據
knowledge.text: 在原創等效電路標記兩電感電流及差值對應的負載電流。
knowledge.textEn: Mark both inductor currents and their load-current difference on an original equivalent circuit.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：Lr=20 μH、Cr=100 nF，串聯諧振 fr=1/(2π√(LrCr))≈112.54 kHz。若 Lm=100 μH，另一理想頻率 1/(2π√((Lr+Lm)Cr))≈45.94 kHz。實際 LLC 增益還依負載、變壓器比及寄生而變。 基波近似用於初步理解，輕載、啟動與大偏離諧振時需時域模型；本課不提供高壓實機調機程序。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: Lr=20 μH and Cr=100 nF give series resonance fr=1/(2π√(LrCr))≈112.54 kHz. With Lm=100 μH, the other ideal frequency is about 45.94 kHz using Lr+Lm. Actual LLC gain also depends on load, turns ratio and parasitics. Fundamental-harmonic approximation is introductory; light load, startup and operation far from resonance need time-domain models, with no live high-voltage tuning instructions.

knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: Lr=20 μH and Cr=100 nF give series resonance fr=1/(2π√(LrCr))≈112.54 kHz. With Lm=100 μH, the other ideal frequency is about 45.94 kHz using Lr+Lm. Actual LLC gain also depends on load, turns ratio and parasitics. Fundamental-harmonic approximation is introductory; light load, startup and operation far from resonance need time-domain models, with no live high-voltage tuning instructions.

quiz.question: 關於「評估磁化電流：反證與驗收」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？
quiz.questionEn: For “Assess magnetizing current: challenge and acceptance”, which claim or verification is justified?
options: 只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
保持功率相同比較 Lm 減半時的磁化電流與 RMS。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
At equal output compare magnetizing and RMS currents when Lm is halved.
quiz.explanation: 較小 Lm 可提供換流能量，但增加循環電流及導通損耗。 保持功率相同比較 Lm 減半時的磁化電流與 RMS。
quiz.explanationEn: Smaller Lm can support commutation but raises circulating current/conduction loss. At equal output compare magnetizing and RMS currents when Lm is halved.

stages.title: 切換與控制
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成切換與控制；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete switching and control through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 辨識感性與容性區：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Distinguish inductive/capacitive regions: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解辨識感性與容性區，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand distinguish inductive/capacitive regions through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 在增益圖旁標相位正負，不單凭效率猜測軟切換。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Mark impedance-phase sign beside gain curves instead of inferring soft switching from efficiency alone. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 在增益圖旁標相位正負，不單凭效率猜測軟切換。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Mark impedance-phase sign beside gain curves instead of inferring soft switching from efficiency alone. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「辨識感性與容性區」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把LLC 雙諧振、增益曲線與軟切換邊界的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If distinguish inductive/capacitive regions disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of LLC dual resonances, gain curves and soft-switching bounds behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「辨識感性與容性區」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for distinguish inductive/capacitive regions, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore phase-shift power transfer, freewheeling, duty loss and ZVS, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.

optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.

steps.title: 比較次級整流方式：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Compare secondary rectification: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解比較次級整流方式，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand compare secondary rectification through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 先沿用模型，寫下會推翻「中心抽頭、全橋和倍流整流有不同器件應力及磁件配置。」的觀察。在相同輸出需求畫三種概念路徑，列出導通器件數。 加入一個對照條件，分開記錄原始數據、推論與不確定度；若前提失效則暫緩判定。
steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: Center-tapped, full-bridge and current-doubler rectification have different stresses/magnetics. Draw three conceptual paths at equal output requirement and count conducting devices. Add a control condition and separate raw data, inference and uncertainty. Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.
steps.observation: 在相同輸出需求畫三種概念路徑，列出導通器件數。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Draw three conceptual paths at equal output requirement and count conducting devices. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「比較次級整流方式」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把移相功率傳遞、續流、占空比損失與 ZVS的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If compare secondary rectification disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of phase-shift power transfer, freewheeling, duty loss and ZVS behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「比較次級整流方式」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for compare secondary rectification, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.text: 在相同輸出需求畫三種概念路徑，列出導通器件數。
knowledge.textEn: Draw three conceptual paths at equal output requirement and count conducting devices.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：理想輸出近似 Vout≈Vin·(Ns/Np)·Deff。Vin=400 V、Ns/Np=0.1、Deff=0.30 時得 12 V；若換流造成有效占空比降至 0.27，則變 10.8 V，需控制補償但仍受最大相移限制。 理想 PWM 模型不包含全部漏感、磁通偏移與整流暫態；工程判讀需時域與元件條件交叉驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: ideally Vout≈Vin·(Ns/Np)·Deff. With 400 V, Ns/Np=0.1 and Deff=0.30 the output is 12 V. Commutation reducing effective duty to 0.27 gives 10.8 V; control can compensate only within the maximum phase-shift limit. Ideal PWM models omit leakage, flux bias and rectifier transients; interpretation needs time-domain and component-condition cross-checks.

steps.check: 交付「區分領先與落後橋臂」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解驗證負載瞬變，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand validate load transients through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 對相同負載階躍記錄輸出欠壓、電流限幅及恢复時間。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: For one load step record output dip, current limiting and recovery time. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 對相同負載階躍記錄輸出欠壓、電流限幅及恢复時間。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: For one load step record output dip, current limiting and recovery time. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「驗證負載瞬變」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把移相功率傳遞、續流、占空比損失與 ZVS的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If validate load transients disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of phase-shift power transfer, freewheeling, duty loss and ZVS behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「驗證負載瞬變」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for validate load transients, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 驗證負載瞬變：原理
knowledge.text: 快電流環不保證輸出電容與外環能满足負載階躍。
knowledge.textEn: A fast current loop does not alone ensure output-capacitor/outer-loop load-step performance.

knowledge.title: 驗證負載瞬變：證據
knowledge.text: 對相同負載階躍記錄輸出欠壓、電流限幅及恢复時間。
knowledge.textEn: For one load step record output dip, current limiting and recovery time.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：理想輸出近似 Vout≈Vin·(Ns/Np)·Deff。Vin=400 V、Ns/Np=0.1、Deff=0.30 時得 12 V；若換流造成有效占空比降至 0.27，則變 10.8 V，需控制補償但仍受最大相移限制。 理想 PWM 模型不包含全部漏感、磁通偏移與整流暫態；工程判讀需時域與元件條件交叉驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: ideally Vout≈Vin·(Ns/Np)·Deff. With 400 V, Ns/Np=0.1 and Deff=0.30 the output is 12 V. Commutation reducing effective duty to 0.27 gives 10.8 V; control can compensate only within the maximum phase-shift limit. Ideal PWM models omit leakage, flux bias and rectifier transients; interpretation needs time-domain and component-condition cross-checks.

以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: A fast current loop does not alone ensure output-capacitor/outer-loop load-step performance.
If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: 快電流環不保證輸出電容與外環能满足負載階躍。 對相同負載階躍記錄輸出欠壓、電流限幅及恢复時間。
quiz.explanationEn: A fast current loop does not alone ensure output-capacitor/outer-loop load-step performance. For one load step record output dip, current limiting and recovery time.

vendorHints.role: 移相全橋數位控制參考設計
vendorHints.roleEn: Digital PSFB reference designs

title: 雙主動橋雙向轉換器
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討雙橋相移、漏感功率傳遞與雙向控制，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore dual-bridge phase shift, leakage-inductance power transfer and bidirectional control, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。公式假設理想方波、忽略磁化與電阻且採定義一致的單相移；大相移和電壓失配需檢查 RMS 電流及 ZVS 邊界。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. The formula assumes ideal square waves, neglected magnetizing/resistive effects and consistent single-phase-shift definitions; large shifts and mismatch require RMS-current/ZVS checks.

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解建立 ZVS 電流條件，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand build zvs current conditions through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 逐個橋臂標切換電流符號，不以總功率方向推定全部 ZVS。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Mark commutation-current signs per leg; do not infer all ZVS from net power direction. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 逐個橋臂標切換電流符號，不以總功率方向推定全部 ZVS。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Mark commutation-current signs per leg; do not infer all ZVS from net power direction. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「建立 ZVS 電流條件」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把雙橋相移、漏感功率傳遞與雙向控制的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If build zvs current conditions disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of dual-bridge phase shift, leakage-inductance power transfer and bidirectional control behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「建立 ZVS 電流條件」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for build zvs current conditions, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 建立 ZVS 電流條件：原理
knowledge.text: 各切換瞬間的電流方向和幅度決定是否能充放節點電容。
knowledge.textEn: Current sign/magnitude at each transition determines node-capacitance commutation.

knowledge.title: 建立 ZVS 電流條件：證據
knowledge.text: 逐個橋臂標切換電流符號，不以總功率方向推定全部 ZVS。
knowledge.textEn: Mark commutation-current signs per leg; do not infer all ZVS from net power direction.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：理想單相移 DAB，P=V1·V2′/(ωL)·φ(1−abs(φ)/π)，V2′為折算至一次側的方波幅值，φ 用 rad。V1=V2′=400 V、f=100 kHz、L=20 μH、φ=π/6，P≈5.56 kW；反向 φ 改符號。 公式假設理想方波、忽略磁化與電阻且採定義一致的單相移；大相移和電壓失配需檢查 RMS 電流及 ZVS 邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example for ideal single-phase-shift DAB: P=V1·V2′/(ωL)·φ(1−abs(φ)/π), with V2′ the secondary square-wave amplitude referred to the primary and φ in radians. At V1=V2′=400 V, f=100 kHz, L=20 μH and φ=π/6, P≈5.56 kW. Reversing φ reverses power. The formula assumes ideal square waves, neglected magnetizing/resistive effects and consistent single-phase-shift definitions; large shifts and mismatch require RMS-current/ZVS checks.

Current sign/magnitude at each transition determines node-capacitance commutation.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.

title: 隔離式閘極驅動器
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討隔離門極時序、CMTI、Miller 抑制與故障回報，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore isolated-gate timing, CMTI, Miller suppression and fault reporting, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。隔離額定、爬電距離和保護時間須按器件與應用規範審核；本課無高壓實機量測連接方法。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Isolation ratings, creepage and protection timing require device/application review; no high-voltage physical probing instructions are included.

stages.title: 隔離與供電
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成隔離與供電；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete isolation and bias through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 區分訊號與功率隔離：建立模型

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解區分訊號與功率隔離，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。

steps.instruction: 畫出數位輸入、隔離柵、輸出供電和功率器件四個域。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Draw four domains: input, isolation barrier, output bias and power device. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 畫出數位輸入、隔離柵、輸出供電和功率器件四個域。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。

steps.failureEn: If separate signal and bias isolation disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of isolated-gate timing, CMTI, Miller suppression and fault reporting behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「區分訊號與功率隔離」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。

knowledge.text: 訊號跨隔離傳遞不等於門極供電已隔離，兩者需各自確認。
knowledge.textEn: Isolated signal transfer does not mean isolated gate power; both need verification.

knowledge.title: 區分訊號與功率隔離：證據
knowledge.titleEn: Separate signal and bias isolation: evidence
knowledge.text: 畫出數位輸入、隔離柵、輸出供電和功率器件四個域。
knowledge.textEn: Draw four domains: input, isolation barrier, output bias and power device.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：總閘極電荷 Qg=100 nC、目標電荷轉移時間 100 ns，簡化平均驅動電流 Qg/t=1 A。實際峰流由門極電阻、驅動器輸出阻抗與 Miller 平台決定；用 Qg·ΔV·fs 估平均閘極驅動功率。 隔離額定、爬電距離和保護時間須按器件與應用規範審核；本課無高壓實機量測連接方法。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: total gate charge Qg=100 nC transferred in 100 ns implies a simplified mean drive current Qg/t=1 A. Actual peak current depends on gate resistance, driver impedance and the Miller plateau; Qg·ΔV·fs estimates average gate-drive power. Isolation ratings, creepage and protection timing require device/application review; no high-voltage physical probing instructions are included.

title: 電流感測與保護電路
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討分流、磁性感測、量測誤差與快速保護，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore shunts, magnetic sensing, measurement errors and fast protection, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。感測器頻寬或量測精度不代表保護已足夠；隔離、過載和故障切離需獨立證據，不提供實機故障注入指令。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Sensor bandwidth/accuracy does not establish sufficient protection; isolation, overload and interruption need independent evidence, without physical fault-injection instructions.

knowledge.text: 用同一電流範圍比較插入損耗、DC 能力和隔離需求。
knowledge.textEn: At equal range compare insertion loss, DC capability and isolation requirements.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：Rshunt=1 mΩ、I=50 A，壓降 50 mV、耗散 I²R=2.5 W。若增益 20 V/V，輸出訊號增量 1 V；輸入偏移 25 μV 相當於 25 mA 電流誤差，不包含增益、溫漂和 ADC 誤差。 感測器頻寬或量測精度不代表保護已足夠；隔離、過載和故障切離需獨立證據，不提供實機故障注入指令。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 1 mΩ shunt at 50 A drops 50 mV and dissipates I²R=2.5 W. Gain 20 V/V yields a 1 V signal increment. A 25 μV input offset equals 25 mA current error, excluding gain, drift and ADC errors. Sensor bandwidth/accuracy does not establish sufficient protection; isolation, overload and interruption need independent evidence, without physical fault-injection instructions.

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解同步 PWM 取樣，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand synchronize pwm sampling through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 在離線 PWM 周期掃描取樣相位，標出可用窗口。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Sweep sample phase over an offline PWM cycle and mark usable windows. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 在離線 PWM 周期掃描取樣相位，標出可用窗口。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Sweep sample phase over an offline PWM cycle and mark usable windows. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「同步 PWM 取樣」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把分流、磁性感測、量測誤差與快速保護的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If synchronize pwm sampling disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of shunts, magnetic sensing, measurement errors and fast protection behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「同步 PWM 取樣」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for synchronize pwm sampling, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 同步 PWM 取樣：原理
knowledge.text: 取樣時刻若靠近切換邊沿，尖峰和放大器恢復會污染讀值。
knowledge.textEn: Sampling near switching edges captures spikes and amplifier recovery artifacts.

knowledge.title: 同步 PWM 取樣：證據
knowledge.text: 在離線 PWM 周期掃描取樣相位，標出可用窗口。
knowledge.textEn: Sweep sample phase over an offline PWM cycle and mark usable windows.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：Rshunt=1 mΩ、I=50 A，壓降 50 mV、耗散 I²R=2.5 W。若增益 20 V/V，輸出訊號增量 1 V；輸入偏移 25 μV 相當於 25 mA 電流誤差，不包含增益、溫漂和 ADC 誤差。 感測器頻寬或量測精度不代表保護已足夠；隔離、過載和故障切離需獨立證據，不提供實機故障注入指令。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 1 mΩ shunt at 50 A drops 50 mV and dissipates I²R=2.5 W. Gain 20 V/V yields a 1 V signal increment. A 25 μV input offset equals 25 mA current error, excluding gain, drift and ADC errors. Sensor bandwidth/accuracy does not establish sufficient protection; isolation, overload and interruption need independent evidence, without physical fault-injection instructions.

quiz.question: 關於「同步 PWM 取樣：建立模型」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？
quiz.questionEn: For “Synchronize PWM sampling: build the model”, which claim or verification is justified?
options: 取樣時刻若靠近切換邊沿，尖峰和放大器恢復會污染讀值。
只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: Sampling near switching edges captures spikes and amplifier recovery artifacts.
If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: 取樣時刻若靠近切換邊沿，尖峰和放大器恢復會污染讀值。 在離線 PWM 周期掃描取樣相位，標出可用窗口。
quiz.explanationEn: Sampling near switching edges captures spikes and amplifier recovery artifacts. Sweep sample phase over an offline PWM cycle and mark usable windows.

title: 電力電子散熱設計
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究損耗、熱阻網路與暫態熱容量；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate losses, thermal networks and transient heat capacity. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設元件損耗 20 W，接面至冷卻液總熱阻 1.8 K/W，冷卻液 35°C，穩態接面估計 71°C；若損耗 30 W，估計 89°C。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 20 W device loss, 1.8 K/W total junction-to-coolant resistance and 35°C coolant: steady junction temperature is 71°C; 30 W gives 89°C.
workedExample.assumptions: 線性穩態近似，熱阻依安裝、流量與溫度而變；不把資料表 RθJA 當成任意機箱熱阻。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Linear steady approximation; resistance depends on mounting, flow and temperature. Datasheet RθJA is not arbitrary enclosure resistance.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

stages.title: 損耗與邊界
stages.description: 以三個技術單元逐一建立「損耗與邊界」的模型和可反駁的驗證證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units build models and falsifiable verification evidence for losses and boundaries.

steps.title: 損耗分解：模型與設計
steps.objective: 以「損耗分解」建立可檢驗的模型，明確標出座標、變數、單位和有效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable model for loss decomposition, stating coordinates, variables, units and validity bounds.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。導通 I²R 與每次開關能量乘頻率是不同熱源；R 隨溫度改變。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「分別掃描電流和頻率，判別平方電流與頻率相關項。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. Conduction I²R and switching energy times frequency are distinct heat sources; R changes with temperature. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: Sweep current and frequency separately to distinguish quadratic-current and frequency-dependent terms. List unmeasured conditions; animation positions are not physical dimensions.
steps.check: 提交「損耗分解」兩狀態圖、變數單位表和預期差異；以本步判別方法說明何種結果會推翻模型。
steps.checkEn: Submit two states, a variable/unit table and predicted differences for loss decomposition; specify which diagnostic result would falsify the model.
steps.observation: 分別掃描電流和頻率，判別平方電流與頻率相關項。
steps.observationEn: Sweep current and frequency separately to distinguish quadratic-current and frequency-dependent terms.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：只有輸出功率決定晶片損耗。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Output power alone determines die loss. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

knowledge.title: 物理機制與系統邊界
knowledge.text: 導通 I²R 與每次開關能量乘頻率是不同熱源；R 隨溫度改變。
knowledge.textEn: Conduction I²R and switching energy times frequency are distinct heat sources; R changes with temperature.

knowledge.title: 判別方法與證據
knowledge.text: 分別掃描電流和頻率，判別平方電流與頻率相關項。
knowledge.textEn: Sweep current and frequency separately to distinguish quadratic-current and frequency-dependent terms.

knowledge.title: 課程量化模型與適用界限
knowledge.titleEn: Course quantitative model and validity limits
knowledge.text: ΔT=P·Rθ；一階暫態 ΔT(t)=P·Rθ(1−exp(−t/τ))。 線性穩態近似，熱阻依安裝、流量與溫度而變；不把資料表 RθJA 當成任意機箱熱阻。
knowledge.textEn: ΔT=P·Rθ; first-order transient ΔT(t)=P·Rθ(1−exp(−t/τ)). Linear steady approximation; resistance depends on mounting, flow and temperature. Datasheet RθJA is not arbitrary enclosure resistance.

quiz.question: 審查「損耗分解」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for loss decomposition?
options: 導通 I²R 與每次開關能量乘頻率是不同熱源；R 隨溫度改變。
只有輸出功率決定晶片損耗。
室溫一定等於散熱器入口空氣溫度。
optionsEn: Conduction I²R and switching energy times frequency are distinct heat sources; R changes with temperature.
Output power alone determines die loss.
Room temperature always equals heat-sink inlet air temperature.
quiz.explanation: 導通 I²R 與每次開關能量乘頻率是不同熱源；R 隨溫度改變。 分別掃描電流和頻率，判別平方電流與頻率相關項。
quiz.explanationEn: Conduction I²R and switching energy times frequency are distinct heat sources; R changes with temperature. Sweep current and frequency separately to distinguish quadratic-current and frequency-dependent terms.

steps.title: 損耗分解：量測與判別

title: 電力電子電磁干擾濾波
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究共模、差模與阻抗交互作用；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate common mode, differential mode and impedance interactions. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 教學 L=10 µH、C=1 µF 得 f₀≈50.3 kHz；僅在理想漸近區，頻率提高十倍多約 40 dB 衰減。
workedExample.textEn: Teaching values L=10 µH and C=1 µF give f₀≈50.3 kHz; only in the ideal asymptotic region does a tenfold frequency rise add about 40 dB attenuation.
workedExample.assumptions: 未包含來源與負載阻抗、ESR/ESL 或寄生共振；不得用此算例宣稱符合 EMC。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Excludes source/load impedance, ESR/ESL and parasitic resonances; the example does not establish EMC compliance.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

title: 高精度類比訊號調理
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究微弱訊號、誤差預算與校準；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate small signals, error budgets and calibration. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設感測器滿刻度 20 mV、G=100，輸出跨度 2 V；輸入失調 10 µV 對應輸出 1 mV，為滿刻度 0.05%。
workedExample.textEn: Assume a 20 mV sensor span and G=100: output span is 2 V; 10 µV input offset becomes 1 mV output error, or 0.05% of span.
workedExample.assumptions: 線性小訊號且未飽和；固定誤差用界限和、獨立隨機誤差才可用均方根。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Linear small-signal operation without saturation; bound systematic errors and use root-sum-square only for independent random errors.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

title: 低雜訊放大器設計
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究雜訊匹配、增益與穩定性；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate noise matching, gain and stability. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

steps.title: 回授與寄生：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Feedback and parasitics: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「回授與寄生」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in feedback and parasitics, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。改變負載相位，觀察模型中的輸入反射與增益。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「反向傳输與接地寄生讓輸出負載影響輸入。」和待排除假說「S12 永遠是零，因此輸入輸出完全獨立。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Vary load phase and observe input reflection and gain in the model. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Reverse transmission and ground parasitics let the output load affect the input.” with the hypothesis to reject “S12 is always zero, making input and output independent.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：改變負載相位，觀察模型中的輸入反射與增益。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Vary load phase and observe input reflection and gain in the model. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 改變負載相位，觀察模型中的輸入反射與增益。
steps.observationEn: Vary load phase and observe input reflection and gain in the model.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：S12 永遠是零，因此輸入輸出完全獨立。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: S12 is always zero, making input and output independent. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate phase feedback, noise shaping and lock acquisition. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

title: 高速類比數位轉換器
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究取樣、量化、時鐘與高速介面；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate sampling, quantization, clocks and high-speed interfaces. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設 fin=100 MHz、總 RMS 抖動 100 fs，抖動限制 SNR≈84.0 dB；fin 增至 200 MHz 降至約 78.0 dB。
workedExample.textEn: With fin=100 MHz and total RMS jitter of 100 fs, jitter-limited SNR≈84.0 dB; fin=200 MHz reduces it to about 78.0 dB.
workedExample.assumptions: 正弦、小時間誤差、抖動與輸入不相關；此值未包含量化、熱雜訊與失真。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Sinusoidal input, small timing errors and uncorrelated jitter; excludes quantization, thermal noise and distortion.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

title: 射頻功率放大器
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究射頻功率、效率與線性；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate RF power, efficiency and linearity. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設輸出 10 W、輸入 0.1 W、直流輸入 25 W，PAE=39.6%；汲極效率為 40%，兩者不同。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 10 W output, 0.1 W input and 25 W DC input: PAE=39.6%; drain efficiency is 40%, a different metric.
workedExample.assumptions: 同時刻平均實功率，未含外部供電轉換損耗；不等於整機效率。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Average real powers measured consistently; excludes external supply-conversion losses and is not complete-system efficiency.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

title: 射頻濾波器與雙工器
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究聲學濾波、損失與收發隔離；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate acoustic filtering, loss and transmit/receive isolation. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 教學通帶中心 2 GHz、3 dB 頻寬 100 MHz，載入 Q≈20；若 abs(S21)=0.794，插入損耗約 2.00 dB。
workedExample.textEn: A teaching passband at 2 GHz with 100 MHz 3 dB bandwidth has loaded Q≈20; abs(S21)=0.794 corresponds to about 2.00 dB insertion loss.
workedExample.assumptions: 單一近似帶通的載入 Q；不可等同材料本徵 Q，也不是特定商用品數據。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Loaded Q of an approximate single bandpass; not intrinsic material Q or a commercial product specification.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

title: 天線阻抗匹配網路
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究阻抗、輻射效率與環境失諧；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate impedance, radiation efficiency and environmental detuning. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設 50 Ω 系統接 100 Ω 純電阻，Γ=1/3，VSWR=2，反射功率比 1/9≈11.1%。
workedExample.textEn: A 100 Ω resistive load in a 50 Ω system gives Γ=1/3, VSWR=2 and reflected-power fraction 1/9≈11.1%.
workedExample.assumptions: 單頻、實數參考阻抗；良好匹配不表示高輻射效率。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Single frequency and real reference impedance; good matching does not imply high radiation efficiency.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

steps.title: VNA 校準：量測與判別

steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Check calibration with an independent known verification device. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Open/short/load calibration transfers systematic errors to a defined plane.” with the hypothesis to reject “Changing cables never requires rechecking calibration.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：使用已知驗證件檢查校準而非再用同組標準自證。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Check calibration with an independent known verification device. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 使用已知驗證件檢查校準而非再用同組標準自證。

steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：校準一次之後更换纜線也無需重查。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。

title: 相位陣列天線收發模組
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究相位排列、空間取樣與校準；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate phase progression, spatial sampling and calibration. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 教學間距 d=λ/2、指向 θ=30°，相鄰單元相位差 −90°；座標反向則符號反轉。
workedExample.textEn: For d=λ/2 and steering angle θ=30°, adjacent elements need −90° phase difference; reversing coordinates reverses the sign.
workedExample.assumptions: 遠場、均勻直線陣列和窄頻近似；不含互耦或單元方向圖。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Far-field uniform linear array, narrowband approximation; excludes mutual coupling and element patterns.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

title: 軟體定義無線電前端
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究混頻、IQ 誤差與數位射頻協同；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate mixing, IQ errors and analog/digital co-design. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

steps.title: 零中頻與低中頻：模型與設計

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。零中頻簡化濾波但直流與 1/f 更接近訊號；低中頻需鏡像規劃。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「比較同訊號在兩種架構中的干擾位置。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. Zero IF simplifies filtering but brings DC and 1/f close to signal; low IF needs image planning. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. steps.title: IQ 失衡：模型與設計

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。增益和正交相位誤差產生鏡像。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「單獨注入增益或相位誤差，觀察影像抑制。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. Gain and quadrature phase errors create images. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: Inject gain or phase error separately and observe image rejection. knowledge.text: fIF=abs(fRF−fLO)；複數 IQ 保留正負頻率方向。 理想混頻與固定 IQ 符號約定；真實系統含鏡像、直流偏移及 LO 洩漏。

steps.title: IQ 失衡：量測與判別

stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units build models and falsifiable verification evidence for reproducibility and acceptance.

steps.title: 資料吞吐：模型與設計
steps.objective: 以「資料吞吐」建立可檢驗的模型，明確標出座標、變數、單位和有效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable model for data throughput, stating coordinates, variables, units and validity bounds.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。IQ 每樣本兩個數值，主機緩衝與傳輸可成為瓶頸。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「計算 I/Q 位寬、通道數與取樣率，再核對掉樣計數。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. IQ contains two values per sample; host buffering and transport can bottleneck. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: Calculate IQ width, channels and sample rate, then check dropped-sample counters. List unmeasured conditions; animation positions are not physical dimensions.
steps.check: 提交「資料吞吐」兩狀態圖、變數單位表和預期差異；以本步判別方法說明何種結果會推翻模型。
steps.checkEn: Submit two states, a variable/unit table and predicted differences for data throughput; specify which diagnostic result would falsify the model.
steps.observation: 計算 I/Q 位寬、通道數與取樣率，再核對掉樣計數。
steps.observationEn: Calculate IQ width, channels and sample rate, then check dropped-sample counters.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：RF 波形良好就代表主機沒有掉樣。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: A good RF waveform proves the host drops no samples. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

knowledge.title: 物理機制與系統邊界
knowledge.text: IQ 每樣本兩個數值，主機緩衝與傳輸可成為瓶頸。
knowledge.textEn: IQ contains two values per sample; host buffering and transport can bottleneck.

knowledge.title: 判別方法與證據
knowledge.text: 計算 I/Q 位寬、通道數與取樣率，再核對掉樣計數。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate IQ width, channels and sample rate, then check dropped-sample counters.

knowledge.title: 課程量化模型與適用界限
knowledge.titleEn: Course quantitative model and validity limits
knowledge.text: fIF=abs(fRF−fLO)；複數 IQ 保留正負頻率方向。 理想混頻與固定 IQ 符號約定；真實系統含鏡像、直流偏移及 LO 洩漏。
knowledge.textEn: fIF=abs(fRF−fLO); complex IQ preserves positive/negative frequency orientation. Ideal mixing with a fixed IQ sign convention; real systems contain images, DC offsets and LO leakage.

quiz.question: 審查「資料吞吐」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for data throughput?
options: RF 波形良好就代表主機沒有掉樣。
一次校準可無條件覆蓋全部射頻範圍。
IQ 每樣本兩個數值，主機緩衝與傳輸可成為瓶頸。
optionsEn: A good RF waveform proves the host drops no samples.
One calibration unconditionally covers the entire RF range.
IQ contains two values per sample; host buffering and transport can bottleneck.
quiz.explanation: IQ 每樣本兩個數值，主機緩衝與傳輸可成為瓶頸。 計算 I/Q 位寬、通道數與取樣率，再核對掉樣計數。
quiz.explanationEn: IQ contains two values per sample; host buffering and transport can bottleneck. Calculate IQ width, channels and sample rate, then check dropped-sample counters.

steps.title: 資料吞吐：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「資料吞吐」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in data throughput, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。計算 I/Q 位寬、通道數與取樣率，再核對掉樣計數。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「IQ 每樣本兩個數值，主機緩衝與傳輸可成為瓶頸。」和待排除假說「RF 波形良好就代表主機沒有掉樣。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Calculate IQ width, channels and sample rate, then check dropped-sample counters. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “IQ contains two values per sample; host buffering and transport can bottleneck.” with the hypothesis to reject “A good RF waveform proves the host drops no samples.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：計算 I/Q 位寬、通道數與取樣率，再核對掉樣計數。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Calculate IQ width, channels and sample rate, then check dropped-sample counters. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 計算 I/Q 位寬、通道數與取樣率，再核對掉樣計數。
steps.observationEn: Calculate IQ width, channels and sample rate, then check dropped-sample counters.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：RF 波形良好就代表主機沒有掉樣。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: A good RF waveform proves the host drops no samples. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

title: 多層印刷電路板製造
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究多層堆疊、回流路徑與製造驗證；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate multilayer stackup, return paths and manufacturing verification. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.textEn: For L=0.10 m, w=0.5 mm, t=35 µm and copper ρ=1.72×10⁻⁸ Ω·m, R≈0.0983 Ω; at 1 A the DC loss is about 0.0983 W.

title: 高密度互連電路板
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究微孔、增層與高密度逃線；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate microvias, buildup and dense escape routing. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

title: 軟硬複合電路板
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究彎曲應變、材料與剛柔交界；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate bending strain, materials and rigid-flex transitions. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設均質薄片 t=0.10 mm、R=10 mm，外表面應變約 0.5%；真實多層銅與膠的中性軸需重算。
workedExample.textEn: For a homogeneous sheet t=0.10 mm and R=10 mm, outer-surface strain is about 0.5%; real copper/adhesive multilayers need a recalculated neutral axis.
workedExample.assumptions: 小應變幾何近似，不是銅疲勞壽命或允許彎曲半徑規格。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Small-strain geometric approximation, not a copper fatigue-life or allowable-radius specification.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

title: 表面黏著生產線
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究錫膏、貼裝與生產線資料閉環；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate paste, placement and production-line feedback. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 教學開口 0.30×0.40 mm、鋼網厚 0.10 mm，理論體積 0.012 mm³；量得 0.0096 mm³ 則轉移效率 80%。
workedExample.textEn: A teaching aperture 0.30×0.40 mm with 0.10 mm stencil gives 0.012 mm³ theoretical volume; 0.0096 mm³ measured means 80% transfer efficiency.
workedExample.assumptions: 矩形幾何近似，不含壁錐、錫膏流變和量測不確定度；不是製程目標值。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Rectangular geometry excludes wall taper, paste rheology and measurement uncertainty; not a process target.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable model for vision alignment, stating coordinates, variables, units and validity bounds.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。板基準點修正整體姿態，局部翹曲仍可能留下位置誤差。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「分離全板平移旋轉和局部殘差。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. Board fiducials correct global pose while local warp can leave placement errors. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: Separate global translation/rotation from local residuals. List unmeasured conditions; animation positions are not physical dimensions.
steps.check: 提交「視覺對位」兩狀態圖、變數單位表和預期差異；以本步判別方法說明何種結果會推翻模型。
steps.checkEn: Submit two states, a variable/unit table and predicted differences for vision alignment; specify which diagnostic result would falsify the model.
steps.observation: 分離全板平移旋轉和局部殘差。
steps.observationEn: Separate global translation/rotation from local residuals.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：三點對位消除所有板材局部形變。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Three-point alignment removes every local deformation. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

knowledge.titleEn: Course quantitative model and validity limits

quiz.question: 審查「視覺對位」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for vision alignment?
options: 三點對位消除所有板材局部形變。
提高吸取速度一定同時提高良率。
板基準點修正整體姿態，局部翹曲仍可能留下位置誤差。
optionsEn: Three-point alignment removes every local deformation.
Higher pickup speed always improves yield.
Board fiducials correct global pose while local warp can leave placement errors.

quiz.explanationEn: Board fiducials correct global pose while local warp can leave placement errors. Separate global translation/rotation from local residuals.

steps.title: 視覺對位：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「視覺對位」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in vision alignment, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。分離全板平移旋轉和局部殘差。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「板基準點修正整體姿態，局部翹曲仍可能留下位置誤差。」和待排除假說「三點對位消除所有板材局部形變。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Separate global translation/rotation from local residuals. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Board fiducials correct global pose while local warp can leave placement errors.” with the hypothesis to reject “Three-point alignment removes every local deformation.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：分離全板平移旋轉和局部殘差。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Separate global translation/rotation from local residuals. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 分離全板平移旋轉和局部殘差。
steps.observationEn: Separate global translation/rotation from local residuals.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：三點對位消除所有板材局部形變。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Three-point alignment removes every local deformation. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

title: 選擇性焊接與回焊控制
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究潤濕、熱曲線與焊點形成；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate wetting, thermal profiles and joint formation. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設 2 g 銅件、cp=385 J/(kg·K)、升溫 150 K，顯熱約 115.5 J；不含焊料熔化和散熱。
workedExample.textEn: For 2 g of copper, cp=385 J/(kg·K) and a 150 K rise, sensible heat is about 115.5 J; solder melting and losses are excluded.
workedExample.assumptions: 定比熱與均溫假設；不可作為實際爐溫或焊接時間配方。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Constant heat capacity and uniform temperature; not an oven-temperature or soldering-time recipe.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。外觀、X 光與機械測試互補，不能互相完全替代。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「保存材料版次、曲線與檢验判據的交叉索引。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. Visual, X-ray and mechanical tests complement rather than fully replace each other. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: Index material revision, profile and acceptance criteria together. List unmeasured conditions; animation positions are not physical dimensions.
steps.check: 提交「檢驗與追溯」兩狀態圖、變數單位表和預期差異；以本步判別方法說明何種結果會推翻模型。

steps.observation: 保存材料版次、曲線與檢验判據的交叉索引。

steps.title: 檢驗與追溯：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Inspection and traceability: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「檢驗與追溯」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in inspection and traceability, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。保存材料版次、曲線與檢验判據的交叉索引。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「外觀、X 光與機械測試互補，不能互相完全替代。」和待排除假說「外觀合格就等於全部長期可靠度合格。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Index material revision, profile and acceptance criteria together. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Visual, X-ray and mechanical tests complement rather than fully replace each other.” with the hypothesis to reject “Visual acceptance equals complete lifetime reliability acceptance.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：保存材料版次、曲線與檢验判據的交叉索引。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Index material revision, profile and acceptance criteria together. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 保存材料版次、曲線與檢验判據的交叉索引。
steps.observationEn: Index material revision, profile and acceptance criteria together.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：外觀合格就等於全部長期可靠度合格。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。

title: 自動光學電路板檢測
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究三維量測、誤報與缺陷回饋；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate 3D measurement, false calls and defect feedback. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假想 100 個真正缺陷中找出 95 個，另誤報 20 個：recall=95%，precision=95/115≈82.6%。
workedExample.textEn: Of 100 hypothetical true defects, 95 are found with 20 false calls: recall=95%, precision=95/115≈82.6%.
workedExample.assumptions: 需有獨立真值標記；不把此示例當任何檢測設備性能。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Requires independent ground truth; these values do not represent any inspection machine.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.
