options: 檢測器的任何建議都應立即無限幅套用。
自動回饋需限幅、版本與回滾，避免誤判放大製程偏移。
最亮的區域必然最高。
optionsEn: Every inspection suggestion should be applied immediately without limits.
Automatic feedback needs limits, versions and rollback to avoid amplifying misclassification.
The brightest region must be highest.
quiz.explanation: 自動回饋需限幅、版本與回滾，避免誤判放大製程偏移。 用回放資料驗證更新前後缺陷與誤報。
quiz.explanationEn: Automatic feedback needs limits, versions and rollback to avoid amplifying misclassification. Replay data to compare defects and false calls before/after updates.

steps.title: 生產回饋：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「生產回饋」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in production feedback, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。用回放資料驗證更新前後缺陷與誤報。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「自動回饋需限幅、版本與回滾，避免誤判放大製程偏移。」和待排除假說「檢測器的任何建議都應立即無限幅套用。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Replay data to compare defects and false calls before/after updates. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Automatic feedback needs limits, versions and rollback to avoid amplifying misclassification.” with the hypothesis to reject “Every inspection suggestion should be applied immediately without limits.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：用回放資料驗證更新前後缺陷與誤報。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Replay data to compare defects and false calls before/after updates. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 用回放資料驗證更新前後缺陷與誤報。
steps.observationEn: Replay data to compare defects and false calls before/after updates.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：檢測器的任何建議都應立即無限幅套用。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Every inspection suggestion should be applied immediately without limits. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

title: 電路板邊界掃描測試
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究TAP 狀態、結構測試與覆蓋邊界；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate TAP states, structural tests and coverage limits. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設總掃描鏈 1,200 bit、TCK=5 MHz，一次移位約 240 µs；100 個向量純移位時間約 24 ms。
workedExample.textEn: For a 1,200-bit chain at 5 MHz TCK, one shift takes about 240 µs; 100 vectors require about 24 ms of shifting alone.
workedExample.assumptions: 忽略 TAP 切換和等待；時鐘速率必須受所有鏈上元件規格限制。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Excludes TAP transitions and waits; clock rate must satisfy every device in the chain.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

title: 電子組件靜電防護
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究帶電、放電路徑與防護稽核；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate charging, discharge paths and control audits. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

title: 汽車電子環境耐久驗證
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究任務剖面、加速模型與失效分析；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate mission profiles, acceleration models and failure analysis. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設 Ea=0.7 eV、使用 85°C、應力 125°C，k=8.617×10⁻⁵ eV/K，AF≈9.8；僅對相同主導機制的模型成立。
workedExample.textEn: Assuming Ea=0.7 eV, use at 85°C, stress at 125°C and k=8.617×10⁻⁵ eV/K gives AF≈9.8, only for the same dominant mechanism.
workedExample.assumptions: 示例 Ea 並非通用常數；不可把此倍率直接轉成汽車電子壽命保證。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Example Ea is not universal; do not turn this factor directly into an automotive lifetime guarantee.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

steps.title: 任務剖面：模型與設計
steps.objective: 以「任務剖面」建立可檢驗的模型，明確標出座標、變數、單位和有效邊界。

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。通電時間、溫度分布與停機環境共同決定應力。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「把產品一年假想使用拆成各溫度停留時間。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. Powered time, temperature distribution and storage environment determine stress. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: Break a hypothetical year into temperature/dwell intervals. List unmeasured conditions; animation positions are not physical dimensions.
steps.check: 提交「任務剖面」兩狀態圖、變數單位表和預期差異；以本步判別方法說明何種結果會推翻模型。
steps.checkEn: Submit two states, a variable/unit table and predicted differences for mission profile; specify which diagnostic result would falsify the model.
steps.observation: 把產品一年假想使用拆成各溫度停留時間。
steps.observationEn: Break a hypothetical year into temperature/dwell intervals.

steps.title: 任務剖面：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「任務剖面」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。

steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。把產品一年假想使用拆成各溫度停留時間。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「通電時間、溫度分布與停機環境共同決定應力。」和待排除假說「只知道最高環境溫度就足够估計所有壽命。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Break a hypothetical year into temperature/dwell intervals. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Powered time, temperature distribution and storage environment determine stress.” with the hypothesis to reject “Maximum ambient temperature alone predicts all life.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：把產品一年假想使用拆成各溫度停留時間。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Break a hypothetical year into temperature/dwell intervals. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 把產品一年假想使用拆成各溫度停留時間。
steps.observationEn: Break a hypothetical year into temperature/dwell intervals.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：只知道最高環境溫度就足够估計所有壽命。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Maximum ambient temperature alone predicts all life. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

title: 醫療電子隔離電源
titleEn: Isolated power supplies for medical electronics
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究隔離屏障、漏電與系統安全證據；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate isolation barriers, leakage and system safety evidence. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: One ideal capacitor and sinusoidal voltage; actual testing needs applicable standards, equipment classification and a qualified lab.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

options: 只隔離電源就保證整個系統完全隔離。
變壓器兩側之間沒有任何高頻耦合。
電源、資料、屏蔽和接地都可能跨越屏障。
optionsEn: Isolating power alone fully isolates the system.
There is no high-frequency coupling across a transformer.
Power, data, shields and grounds can all cross the barrier.
quiz.explanation: 電源、資料、屏蔽和接地都可能跨越屏障。 逐條標記跨屏障路徑和寄生電容。
quiz.explanationEn: Power, data, shields and grounds can all cross the barrier. Mark every barrier-crossing path and capacitance.

steps.title: 系統屏障：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「系統屏障」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in system barrier, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。逐條標記跨屏障路徑和寄生電容。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「電源、資料、屏蔽和接地都可能跨越屏障。」和待排除假說「只隔離電源就保證整個系統完全隔離。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Mark every barrier-crossing path and capacitance. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Power, data, shields and grounds can all cross the barrier.” with the hypothesis to reject “Isolating power alone fully isolates the system.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：逐條標記跨屏障路徑和寄生電容。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Mark every barrier-crossing path and capacitance. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 逐條標記跨屏障路徑和寄生電容。
steps.observationEn: Mark every barrier-crossing path and capacitance.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：只隔離電源就保證整個系統完全隔離。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Isolating power alone fully isolates the system. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

title: LED 固態照明驅動
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究恆流、調光與熱光耦合；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate constant current, dimming and electrothermal coupling. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例

workedExample.assumptions: 理想穩態恆流近似；實際基準、峰值／平均控制定義依器件資料表。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Ideal steady current approximation; actual reference and peak/average control depend on the device.

workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

quiz.question: 審查「順向壓降」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for forward voltage?
options: 冷態和熱態 Vf 影響驅動餘裕和耗散。
只看典型 Vf 就足以定義所有工作條件。
升壓拓撲可無條件穩壓到低於輸入。
optionsEn: Cold/hot Vf affects headroom and dissipation.
Typical Vf alone defines all operating conditions.
Boost topology regulates below input unconditionally.
quiz.explanation: 冷態和熱態 Vf 影響驅動餘裕和耗散。 以最低和最高串壓檢查供電範圍。
quiz.explanationEn: Cold/hot Vf affects headroom and dissipation. Check supply range against minimum/maximum string voltage.

steps.title: 順向壓降：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「順向壓降」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in forward voltage, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。以最低和最高串壓檢查供電範圍。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「冷態和熱態 Vf 影響驅動餘裕和耗散。」和待排除假說「只看典型 Vf 就足以定義所有工作條件。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Check supply range against minimum/maximum string voltage. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Cold/hot Vf affects headroom and dissipation.” with the hypothesis to reject “Typical Vf alone defines all operating conditions.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：以最低和最高串壓檢查供電範圍。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Check supply range against minimum/maximum string voltage. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 以最低和最高串壓檢查供電範圍。
steps.observationEn: Check supply range against minimum/maximum string voltage.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：只看典型 Vf 就足以定義所有工作條件。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Typical Vf alone defines all operating conditions. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

title: 電子紙顯示驅動系統
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究電泳、雙穩態與更新波形；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate electrophoresis, bistability and update waveforms. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設每次更新 0.20 J、每分鐘一次，平均更新功率約 3.33 mW；若其餘電路待機 1 mW，總平均約 4.33 mW。
workedExample.textEn: At an assumed 0.20 J/update and one update/minute, average update power is about 3.33 mW; adding 1 mW electronics standby gives about 4.33 mW.
workedExample.assumptions: 能量為假設，需按實際顯示尺寸、內容、波形與溫度量測；雙穩態不表示整機零待機。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Assumed energy; measure actual size, content, waveform and temperature. Bistability does not imply zero whole-device standby.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

title: OLED 顯示模組整合
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究自發光像素、供電與顯示補償；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate emissive pixels, power and display compensation. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

title: 觸控面板電容感測
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究自容、互容與抗干擾判讀；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate self/mutual capacitance and interference discrimination. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假想觸摸差值 120 count、未觸摸 RMS 雜訊 10 count，SNR=12（約 21.6 dB）；仍需指定頻寬與資料窗。
workedExample.textEn: Assumed touch delta 120 counts and untouched RMS noise 10 counts give SNR=12, about 21.6 dB; bandwidth and record window still need definition.
workedExample.assumptions: 控制器計數只是相對量，不能跨裝置直接當皮法；範例不是辨識門檻。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Controller counts are relative and not directly picofarads across devices; this example is not a detection threshold.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

knowledge.textEn: Charger/display noise may lie near scan frequencies.

knowledge.title: 判別方法與證據
knowledge.text: 比較有無噪聲源和不同掃頻的計數頻譜。
knowledge.textEn: Compare count spectra with/without noise and at different scan rates.

knowledge.title: 課程量化模型與適用界限
knowledge.titleEn: Course quantitative model and validity limits
knowledge.text: Q=C·V；簡化 SNR=touch delta/RMS noise。 控制器計數只是相對量，不能跨裝置直接當皮法；範例不是辨識門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Q=C·V; simplified SNR=touch delta/RMS noise. Controller counts are relative and not directly picofarads across devices; this example is not a detection threshold.

quiz.question: 審查「抗擾與頻率」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for interference and frequency?
options: 充電器與顯示驅動噪聲可接近掃描頻率。
差值大就可忽略全部頻域干擾。
輸出兩個座標就證明任何雙指都可分辨。
optionsEn: Charger/display noise may lie near scan frequencies.
A large delta permits ignoring all spectral interference.
Two output coordinates prove every pair of touches is distinguishable.
quiz.explanation: 充電器與顯示驅動噪聲可接近掃描頻率。 比較有無噪聲源和不同掃頻的計數頻譜。
quiz.explanationEn: Charger/display noise may lie near scan frequencies. Compare count spectra with/without noise and at different scan rates.

steps.title: 抗擾與頻率：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Interference and frequency: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「抗擾與頻率」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in interference and frequency, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。比較有無噪聲源和不同掃頻的計數頻譜。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「充電器與顯示驅動噪聲可接近掃描頻率。」和待排除假說「差值大就可忽略全部頻域干擾。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Compare count spectra with/without noise and at different scan rates. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Charger/display noise may lie near scan frequencies.” with the hypothesis to reject “A large delta permits ignoring all spectral interference.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：比較有無噪聲源和不同掃頻的計數頻譜。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Compare count spectra with/without noise and at different scan rates. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 比較有無噪聲源和不同掃頻的計數頻譜。
steps.observationEn: Compare count spectra with/without noise and at different scan rates.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：差值大就可忽略全部頻域干擾。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: A large delta permits ignoring all spectral interference. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units build models and falsifiable verification evidence for recognition and validation.

steps.title: 多點辨識：模型與設計
steps.objective: 以「多點辨識」建立可檢驗的模型，明確標出座標、變數、單位和有效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable model for multi-touch, stating coordinates, variables, units and validity bounds.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。感測矩陣的幽靈點和鄰近觸摸需以空間資料處理。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「比較單指和雙指原始矩陣而非只看最後座標。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. Ghost points and nearby touches require spatial matrix analysis. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: Compare raw single-/dual-touch matrices, not only coordinates. List unmeasured conditions; animation positions are not physical dimensions.
steps.check: 提交「多點辨識」兩狀態圖、變數單位表和預期差異；以本步判別方法說明何種結果會推翻模型。

steps.observation: 比較單指和雙指原始矩陣而非只看最後座標。
steps.observationEn: Compare raw single-/dual-touch matrices, not only coordinates.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：輸出兩個座標就證明任何雙指都可分辨。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Two output coordinates prove every pair of touches is distinguishable. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

title: 壓電致動器驅動電路
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究電容負載、機械共振與位移回授；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate capacitive loading, mechanical resonance and displacement feedback. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.text: 假設 C=1 µF、f=1 kHz、Vpk=10 V，Ipk≈62.8 mA；這只是電容電流，未包含機械負載。

workedExample.assumptions: 小訊號線性電容近似；真實壓電電容、位移與耗損隨偏壓和頻率變化。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Small-signal linear-capacitance approximation; actual capacitance, displacement and loss vary with bias/frequency.

quiz.question: 審查「負載驗證」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for loaded validation?
options: 空載照片可以證明所有受力定位性能。
實際位移要在指定力、溫度和行程內驗證。
任何方向的電場都產生相同位移。
optionsEn: An unloaded photo proves all loaded positioning performance.
Displacement must be checked at defined force, temperature and stroke.
Fields in all directions cause identical displacement.

steps.title: 負載驗證：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「負載驗證」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in loaded validation, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。保存負載、位移感測和驅動波形同步記錄。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「實際位移要在指定力、溫度和行程內驗證。」和待排除假說「空載照片可以證明所有受力定位性能。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Retain synchronized load, position and drive records. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Displacement must be checked at defined force, temperature and stroke.” with the hypothesis to reject “An unloaded photo proves all loaded positioning performance.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：保存負載、位移感測和驅動波形同步記錄。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Retain synchronized load, position and drive records. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 保存負載、位移感測和驅動波形同步記錄。
steps.observationEn: Retain synchronized load, position and drive records.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：空載照片可以證明所有受力定位性能。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: An unloaded photo proves all loaded positioning performance. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

title: 超音波換能器電子系統
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究聲電諧振、回波與飛行時間；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate electroacoustic resonance, echoes and time of flight. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設空氣聲速 343 m/s、往返時間 2.0 ms，距離 0.343 m；若誤忘除 2，結果會大一倍。
workedExample.textEn: Assuming air sound speed 343 m/s and round-trip time 2.0 ms, distance is 0.343 m; omitting division by two doubles the result.
workedExample.assumptions: 單一反射路徑與固定聲速近似；溫度、濕度、氣流和多路徑需另外評估。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Single reflection path and fixed sound speed; temperature, humidity, flow and multipath require additional assessment.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

quiz.question: 審查「多路徑」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for multipath?
options: 每個回波都代表獨立直線目標。
單一距離校準可分開所有時間偏差。
牆面和結構產生額外反射，延遲不一定對應直達距離。
optionsEn: Every echo represents a separate line-of-sight target.
One distance calibration separates every timing error.
Walls/structures create extra echoes whose delay need not reflect direct range.
quiz.explanation: 牆面和結構產生額外反射，延遲不一定對應直達距離。 畫出直達與反射路徑長度。
quiz.explanationEn: Walls/structures create extra echoes whose delay need not reflect direct range. Draw direct and reflected path lengths.

steps.title: 多路徑：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「多路徑」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in multipath, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。畫出直達與反射路徑長度。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「牆面和結構產生額外反射，延遲不一定對應直達距離。」和待排除假說「每個回波都代表獨立直線目標。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Draw direct and reflected path lengths. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Walls/structures create extra echoes whose delay need not reflect direct range.” with the hypothesis to reject “Every echo represents a separate line-of-sight target.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：畫出直達與反射路徑長度。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Draw direct and reflected path lengths. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 畫出直達與反射路徑長度。
steps.observationEn: Draw direct and reflected path lengths.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：每個回波都代表獨立直線目標。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Every echo represents a separate line-of-sight target. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。電子延遲與閾值時間游走會偏移飛行時間。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「用多個已知距離分離固定延遲與比例誤差。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. Electronic delay and threshold time walk bias flight time. steps.observation: 用多個已知距離分離固定延遲與比例誤差。

title: 工業感測器隔離通訊
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究差動匯流排、隔離與故障診斷；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate differential buses, isolation and fault diagnosis. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設纜線 100 m、速度 2×10⁸ m/s，單程延遲 0.5 µs；1 Mbit/s 的 bit 時間 1 µs，不能忽略往返反射。
workedExample.textEn: Assuming 100 m cable at 2×10⁸ m/s, one-way delay is 0.5 µs; at 1 Mbit/s a bit lasts 1 µs, so round-trip reflections cannot be ignored.
workedExample.assumptions: 均勻傳輸線估算；可用速率還受上升時間、拓撲、收發器和協定限制。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Uniform-line estimate; usable rate also depends on rise time, topology, transceiver and protocol.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

quiz.question: 審查「隔離電源 EMI」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for isolated-power emi?
options: 小型隔離電源的高頻磁耦合和寄生可能成為輻射源。
整合隔離電源一定完全沒有 EMI。
CMTI 數值可直接當成隔離電壓。
optionsEn: High-frequency magnetic coupling/parasitics in compact isolated supplies can radiate.
Integrated isolated power necessarily has no EMI.
CMTI can be directly treated as isolation voltage.
quiz.explanation: 小型隔離電源的高頻磁耦合和寄生可能成為輻射源。 分開電源和資料切換頻譜定位來源。
quiz.explanationEn: High-frequency magnetic coupling/parasitics in compact isolated supplies can radiate. Separate power and data switching spectra.

steps.title: 隔離電源 EMI：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「隔離電源 EMI」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in isolated-power emi, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。分開電源和資料切換頻譜定位來源。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「小型隔離電源的高頻磁耦合和寄生可能成為輻射源。」和待排除假說「整合隔離電源一定完全沒有 EMI。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Separate power and data switching spectra. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “High-frequency magnetic coupling/parasitics in compact isolated supplies can radiate.” with the hypothesis to reject “Integrated isolated power necessarily has no EMI.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：分開電源和資料切換頻譜定位來源。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Separate power and data switching spectra. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 分開電源和資料切換頻譜定位來源。
steps.observationEn: Separate power and data switching spectra.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：整合隔離電源一定完全沒有 EMI。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Integrated isolated power necessarily has no EMI. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

quiz.question: 審查「失效安全」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for failsafe?
options: 開路、短路與空閒輸入的接收狀態依器件定義。
failsafe 標示代表所有故障都會自動修復。
隔離收發器自動加密並驗證所有資料。
optionsEn: Receiver states for open, short and idle depend on device definitions.
Failsafe means every fault is automatically repaired.
An isolated transceiver automatically encrypts/authenticates all data.

steps.title: 失效安全：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「失效安全」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in failsafe, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。在概念模型中逐一標記三種狀態。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「開路、短路與空閒輸入的接收狀態依器件定義。」和待排除假說「failsafe 標示代表所有故障都會自動修復。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Mark all three states in a conceptual model. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Receiver states for open, short and idle depend on device definitions.” with the hypothesis to reject “Failsafe means every fault is automatically repaired.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：在概念模型中逐一標記三種狀態。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Mark all three states in a conceptual model. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 在概念模型中逐一標記三種狀態。
steps.observationEn: Mark all three states in a conceptual model.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：failsafe 標示代表所有故障都會自動修復。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Failsafe means every fault is automatically repaired. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

knowledge.textEn: Propagation delay t=L/v; terminal reflection Γ=(ZL−Z₀)/(ZL+Z₀). Uniform-line estimate; usable rate also depends on rise time, topology, transceiver and protocol.

quiz.question: 審查「環境驗證」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for environmental validation?
options: 線長、節點數、干擾與供電組合需建立邊界。
短線桌上通過就代表最長工廠網路通過。
差動通訊完全不需要考慮地電位差。
optionsEn: Length, node count, interference and supply combinations define boundaries.
A short bench cable passing proves the longest plant network passes.
Differential communication never needs ground-potential analysis.
quiz.explanation: 線長、節點數、干擾與供電組合需建立邊界。 保存可重現拓撲及失敗率統計。
quiz.explanationEn: Length, node count, interference and supply combinations define boundaries. Retain reproducible topology and failure-rate statistics.

steps.title: 環境驗證：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「環境驗證」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in environmental validation, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。保存可重現拓撲及失敗率統計。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「線長、節點數、干擾與供電組合需建立邊界。」和待排除假說「短線桌上通過就代表最長工廠網路通過。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Retain reproducible topology and failure-rate statistics. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Length, node count, interference and supply combinations define boundaries.” with the hypothesis to reject “A short bench cable passing proves the longest plant network passes.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：保存可重現拓撲及失敗率統計。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Retain reproducible topology and failure-rate statistics. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 保存可重現拓撲及失敗率統計。
steps.observationEn: Retain reproducible topology and failure-rate statistics.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：短線桌上通過就代表最長工廠網路通過。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: A short bench cable passing proves the longest plant network passes. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

title: 日本北海道本州高壓直流連線案例
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究島嶼互聯、VSC 增建與韌性規劃；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate island interconnection, a VSC addition and resilience planning. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 以 2019 年公開新連線額定 250 kVdc、1,200 Adc 作端口核算，P=300 MW；此乘法未計換流與線路損耗。
workedExample.textEn: Using published 2019 new-link ratings of 250 kVdc and 1,200 Adc gives P=300 MW; this terminal calculation omits conversion and line losses.
workedExample.assumptions: 本例引用 2019 新北本 VSC 的歷史額定，不表示全部北海道本州連線現況或可用容量。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Uses historical ratings of the 2019 New Hokkaido-Honshu VSC link, not all current interconnection capacity or availability.
workedExample.sourceScope: 2019 年公告的端口額定核算；不表示今日可用容量。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Terminal-rating calculation from the 2019 announcement; not current availability.

steps.objective: 以「案例邊界」建立可檢驗的模型，明確標出座標、變數、單位和有效邊界。

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。2019 新增 300 MW VSC 與既有 600 MW LCC 是不同設備。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「把來源年份、拓撲及容量分欄，不合併成同一設備。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. The 2019 300 MW VSC addition and existing 600 MW LCC are distinct assets. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: Separate source year, topology and capacity rather than merging assets. List unmeasured conditions; animation positions are not physical dimensions.

title: 英法海峽 IFA 互連電網案例
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究跨國互聯、海纜與容量交易；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate cross-border interconnection, subsea cables and capacity exchange. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假想 2 GW 連線一天平均輸送 1 GW，電量 24 GWh、以額定為分母的利用率 50%；不是 IFA 的實際調度資料。
workedExample.textEn: A hypothetical 2 GW link averaging 1 GW over a day transfers 24 GWh, or 50% rated-capacity utilization; this is not actual IFA dispatch data.
workedExample.assumptions: 示例不含雙向交換與損耗；真實利用率需說明方向、淨額或絕對流量定義。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Excludes bidirectional exchange and losses; real utilization needs direction and net-versus-absolute-flow definitions.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

title: 紐西蘭 HVDC Inter-Island 連線案例
titleEn: New Zealand HVDC Inter-Island link case study
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究南北島能源互補與資產更新；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate island energy complementarity and asset renewal. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 教學某島需額外 300 MW 持續 4 小時，缺口 1.2 GWh；互聯是否可補足還取決於對端餘裕與剩餘容量。
workedExample.textEn: If an island hypothetically needs an extra 300 MW for 4 hours, the gap is 1.2 GWh; filling it also requires exporting-island surplus and available link capacity.
workedExample.assumptions: 完全是假想調度練習，並非紐西蘭電網當前負載、備援或操作指令。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Entirely hypothetical dispatch exercise, not current New Zealand load, reserve or operating instructions.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

quiz.question: 審查「水力互補」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for hydro complementarity?
options: 互聯永遠只能把電從南島送到北島。
增加互聯額定即可無限制消除缺水能源問題。
南島水力與北島資源可隨水文與需求互補。
optionsEn: The link can only ever transfer south-to-north.
Higher link rating eliminates water-related energy shortages without limit.
South Island hydro and North Island resources can complement each other as hydrology/demand change.
quiz.explanation: 南島水力與北島資源可隨水文與需求互補。 比較濕年與乾年假想能源平衡。
quiz.explanationEn: South Island hydro and North Island resources can complement each other as hydrology/demand change. Compare hypothetical wet-/dry-year energy balances.

steps.title: 水力互補：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「水力互補」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in hydro complementarity, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。比較濕年與乾年假想能源平衡。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「南島水力與北島資源可隨水文與需求互補。」和待排除假說「互聯永遠只能把電從南島送到北島。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Compare hypothetical wet-/dry-year energy balances. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “South Island hydro and North Island resources can complement each other as hydrology/demand change.” with the hypothesis to reject “The link can only ever transfer south-to-north.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：比較濕年與乾年假想能源平衡。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Compare hypothetical wet-/dry-year energy balances. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 比較濕年與乾年假想能源平衡。
steps.observationEn: Compare hypothetical wet-/dry-year energy balances.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：互聯永遠只能把電從南島送到北島。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: The link can only ever transfer south-to-north. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

quiz.question: 審查「極線年代」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for pole eras?
options: Pole 3 就是 1965 年原封不動的 Pole 1。
送端和受端功率永遠完全相同。
Pole 1 退役、Pole 3 在 2013 年替代的歷史不能與原始系統混同。
optionsEn: Pole 3 is the unchanged 1965 Pole 1.
Sending and receiving powers are always identical.
Pole 1 retirement and Pole 3 replacement in 2013 must be distinguished from the original system.
quiz.explanation: Pole 1 退役、Pole 3 在 2013 年替代的歷史不能與原始系統混同。 以來源年份核對極線名稱與事件。
quiz.explanationEn: Pole 1 retirement and Pole 3 replacement in 2013 must be distinguished from the original system. Check pole names/events against dated sources.

steps.title: 極線年代：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「極線年代」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in pole eras, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。以來源年份核對極線名稱與事件。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「Pole 1 退役、Pole 3 在 2013 年替代的歷史不能與原始系統混同。」和待排除假說「Pole 3 就是 1965 年原封不動的 Pole 1。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Check pole names/events against dated sources. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Pole 1 retirement and Pole 3 replacement in 2013 must be distinguished from the original system.” with the hypothesis to reject “Pole 3 is the unchanged 1965 Pole 1.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：以來源年份核對極線名稱與事件。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Check pole names/events against dated sources. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 以來源年份核對極線名稱與事件。
steps.observationEn: Check pole names/events against dated sources.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：Pole 3 就是 1965 年原封不動的 Pole 1。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Pole 3 is the unchanged 1965 Pole 1. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

steps.title: 損耗與方向：模型與設計

steps.objective: 以「損耗與方向」建立可檢驗的模型，明確標出座標、變數、單位和有效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable model for loss and direction, stating coordinates, variables, units and validity bounds.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。雙向輸送的損耗和限制需按方向、電流與交流邊界分析。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「以假想損耗曲線重算送端與受端功率。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. Bidirectional losses/limits depend on direction, current and AC boundaries. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: Use hypothetical loss curves to recalculate sent/received power. List unmeasured conditions; animation positions are not physical dimensions.
steps.check: 提交「損耗與方向」兩狀態圖、變數單位表和預期差異；以本步判別方法說明何種結果會推翻模型。

steps.observationEn: Use hypothetical loss curves to recalculate sent/received power.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：送端和受端功率永遠完全相同。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。

quiz.question: 審查「停機規劃」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for outage planning?
options: 低需求季節就不需要任何停機風險分析。
到某年份所有海纜必定在同一天失效。
維護安排需考慮季節負載與發電可用性。
optionsEn: Low-demand season removes all outage-analysis needs.
All cables necessarily fail on one date at a given age.
Maintenance planning considers seasonal load and generation availability.
quiz.explanation: 維護安排需考慮季節負載與發電可用性。 比較單極與全連線假想停機對能源平衡的影響。
quiz.explanationEn: Maintenance planning considers seasonal load and generation availability. Compare hypothetical single-pole and full-link outage balances.

steps.title: 停機規劃：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「停機規劃」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in outage planning, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。比較單極與全連線假想停機對能源平衡的影響。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「維護安排需考慮季節負載與發電可用性。」和待排除假說「低需求季節就不需要任何停機風險分析。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Compare hypothetical single-pole and full-link outage balances. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Maintenance planning considers seasonal load and generation availability.” with the hypothesis to reject “Low-demand season removes all outage-analysis needs.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：比較單極與全連線假想停機對能源平衡的影響。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Compare hypothetical single-pole and full-link outage balances. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 比較單極與全連線假想停機對能源平衡的影響。
steps.observationEn: Compare hypothetical single-pole and full-link outage balances.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：低需求季節就不需要任何停機風險分析。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Low-demand season removes all outage-analysis needs. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

title: 防禦性資訊安全網路
summary: 以身分、資源與復原證據連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。 原有步驟及進度識別完整保留。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect identity, resources and recovery evidence through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation. Existing steps and progress identities are preserved.
scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop assets and trust boundaries through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 資產身分：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「資產身分」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for asset identity.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「資產身分」的資料、控制與時間關係。IP 可能改變，資產鍵需維持穩定。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「合併兩次假想盤點並查重。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for asset identity. IPs may change; asset keys must remain stable. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Merge two synthetic inventories and check duplicates. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 合併兩次假想盤點並查重。
steps.observationEn: Merge two synthetic inventories and check duplicates.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：內網登入即授權所有資源。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Internal login authorizes every resource. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「資產身分」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「IP 可能改變，資產鍵需維持穩定。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit asset identity two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 資產身分的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: IP 可能改變，資產鍵需維持穩定。
knowledge.textEn: IPs may change; asset keys must remain stable.

knowledge.title: 資產身分的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 合併兩次假想盤點並查重。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Merge two synthetic inventories and check duplicates. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設隔離樣本中有 20 件真實事件：偵測 18 件且另誤報 12 件。召回率=18/20=90%，精確率=18/(18+12)=60%；樣本並非部署成效，未包含事件基準率漂移。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 20 true incidents in an isolated labeled dataset, 18 detected and 12 false alerts. Recall=18/20=90%; precision=18/(18+12)=60%. This is not deployment effectiveness and omits base-rate drift.

quiz.question: 本步審查「資產身分」與整體「防禦性資訊安全網路」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？

options: IP 可能改變，資產鍵需維持穩定。

optionsEn: IPs may change; asset keys must remain stable.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例

workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、邊界與理想化前提；改變版本、工作負載、故障模型或資源條件後重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, boundaries and idealizations; recalculate after version, workload, fault-model or resource changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創算例；官方來源支援原理與背景，不是這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original assumed example; official sources support principles/context, not measurements of these numbers.

title: CPU 管線與分支預測
summary: 以指令相依、投機與精確提交連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect instruction dependencies, speculation and precise retirement through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: 取指與管線資源
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「取指與管線資源」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop fetch and pipeline resources through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: ISA 與微架構：原理與架構
steps.titleEn: ISA and microarchitecture: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「ISA 與微架構」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for isa and microarchitecture.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「ISA 與微架構」的資料、控制與時間關係。相同指令集可用不同管線實作。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較同一指令序列的兩種時程。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for isa and microarchitecture. The same ISA permits different pipelines. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare two schedules for one instruction sequence. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 比較同一指令序列的兩種時程。
steps.observationEn: Compare two schedules for one instruction sequence.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：重新命名也會消除真正 RAW 相依。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Renaming also removes true RAW dependencies. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「ISA 與微架構」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「相同指令集可用不同管線實作。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit isa and microarchitecture two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: ISA 與微架構的原理與邊界
knowledge.titleEn: ISA and microarchitecture principle and boundaries
knowledge.text: 相同指令集可用不同管線實作。
knowledge.textEn: The same ISA permits different pipelines.

knowledge.title: ISA 與微架構的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 比較同一指令序列的兩種時程。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Compare two schedules for one instruction sequence. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設非重疊停頓模型的基礎 CPI=1，分支佔 20%、誤預測率 5%、代價 12 cycles。ΔCPI=0.20×0.05×12=0.12，總 CPI=1.12；3 GHz 執行 10⁹ 指令約 0.373 s。忽略快取及重疊隱藏。
knowledge.textEn: For a nonoverlapping-stall model, base CPI=1, branch fraction=20%, misprediction rate=5%, penalty=12 cycles. ΔCPI=0.12 and total CPI=1.12; 10⁹ instructions at 3 GHz take about 0.373 s, ignoring cache and overlap effects.

quiz.question: 本步審查「ISA 與微架構」與整體「CPU 管線與分支預測」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing isa and microarchitecture within cpu pipelines and branch prediction, which statement or check is supported?
options: 相同指令集可用不同管線實作。
重新命名也會消除真正 RAW 相依。
寬解碼保證所有程式 CPI 同比下降。
optionsEn: The same ISA permits different pipelines.
Renaming also removes true RAW dependencies.
Wider decode guarantees proportional CPI reduction.
quiz.explanation: 相同指令集可用不同管線實作。 比較同一指令序列的兩種時程。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: The same ISA permits different pipelines. Compare two schedules for one instruction sequence. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: ISA 與微架構：實驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: ISA and microarchitecture: experiment and validation
steps.objective: 用「比較同一指令序列的兩種時程。」檢查「ISA 與微架構」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for isa and microarchitecture using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「ISA 與微架構」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：比較同一指令序列的兩種時程。 核對「相同指令集可用不同管線實作。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for isa and microarchitecture and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Compare two schedules for one instruction sequence. Check the principle: The same ISA permits different pipelines. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 比較同一指令序列的兩種時程。
steps.observationEn: Compare two schedules for one instruction sequence.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：重新命名也會消除真正 RAW 相依。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Renaming also removes true RAW dependencies. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「ISA 與微架構」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較同一指令序列的兩種時程。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit isa and microarchitecture input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。

title: 快取一致性多核心系統

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for coherence and consistency. Single-address coherence is not global memory ordering. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Classify one- and two-address tests. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

knowledge.textEn: Independent same-line variables can bounce ownership.

knowledge.title: 假共享的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 比較同列與分列計數器。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Compare same-line and separated counters. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

quiz.question: 本步審查「假共享」與整體「快取一致性多核心系統」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing false sharing within cache-coherent multicore systems, which statement or check is supported?
options: 一致性快取可取代所有同步原語。
獨立變數共行可產生擁有權震盪。
填補變數會消除所有真共享。
optionsEn: Coherent caches replace all synchronization primitives.
Independent same-line variables can bounce ownership.
Padding eliminates all true sharing.
quiz.explanation: 獨立變數共行可產生擁有權震盪。 比較同列與分列計數器。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Independent same-line variables can bounce ownership. Compare same-line and separated counters. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 假共享：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「比較同列與分列計數器。」檢查「假共享」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for false sharing using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「假共享」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：比較同列與分列計數器。 核對「獨立變數共行可產生擁有權震盪。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for false sharing and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Compare same-line and separated counters. Check the principle: Independent same-line variables can bounce ownership. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 比較同列與分列計數器。
steps.observationEn: Compare same-line and separated counters.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：一致性快取可取代所有同步原語。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Coherent caches replace all synchronization primitives. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「假共享」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較同列與分列計數器。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit false sharing input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

steps.title: 真共享：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「真共享」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for true sharing.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「真共享」的資料、控制與時間關係。填補不能消除共同資料的寫入競爭。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「區分共享鎖與分離計數器。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for true sharing. Padding cannot remove genuine shared-write contention. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Distinguish shared locks from separate counters. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 區分共享鎖與分離計數器。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish shared locks from separate counters.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：填補變數會消除所有真共享。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Padding eliminates all true sharing. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「真共享」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「填補不能消除共同資料的寫入競爭。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit true sharing two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for numa locality using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「NUMA 局部性」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：比較本地與遠端模型延遲。 核對「一致性不代表遠端存取無延遲。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for numa locality and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Compare modeled local and remote latency. Check the principle: Coherence does not make remote access free. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 比較本地與遠端模型延遲。
steps.observationEn: Compare modeled local and remote latency.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：填補變數會消除所有真共享。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Padding eliminates all true sharing. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「NUMA 局部性」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較本地與遠端模型延遲。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit numa locality input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

knowledge.title: NUMA 局部性的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 一致性不代表遠端存取無延遲。
knowledge.textEn: Coherence does not make remote access free.

knowledge.title: NUMA 局部性的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 比較本地與遠端模型延遲。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Compare modeled local and remote latency. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

quiz.question: 本步審查「NUMA 局部性」與整體「快取一致性多核心系統」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？

options: 一致性快取可取代所有同步原語。
填補變數會消除所有真共享。
比較本地與遠端模型延遲。
optionsEn: Coherent caches replace all synchronization primitives.
Padding eliminates all true sharing.
Compare modeled local and remote latency.
quiz.explanation: 一致性不代表遠端存取無延遲。 比較本地與遠端模型延遲。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Coherence does not make remote access free. Compare modeled local and remote latency. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

stages.title: 驗證與效能診斷
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「驗證與效能診斷」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。

Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check both invariants in each modeled state. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。

title: GPU 平行運算核心
summary: 以SIMT 執行、資料重用與資源佔用連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。

Threads form blocks mapped to SMs. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. steps.title: 權重駐留：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「權重駐留」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for weight stationary.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「權重駐留」的資料、控制與時間關係。權重駐留減少載入但改變累加路徑。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「繪製一次 tile 的資料移動。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for weight stationary. Stationary weights reduce loads but alter accumulation. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw data movement for one tile. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 繪製一次 tile 的資料移動。
steps.observationEn: Draw data movement for one tile.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：BF16 與 FP16 有相同指數和尾數配置。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: BF16 and FP16 have identical exponent and mantissa layouts. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「權重駐留」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「權重駐留減少載入但改變累加路徑。」。

steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for weight stationary and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Draw data movement for one tile. Check the principle: Stationary weights reduce loads but alter accumulation. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. steps.check: 提交「權重駐留」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「繪製一次 tile 的資料移動。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit weight stationary input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「集體通訊」的資料、控制與時間關係。分散工作需支付資料交換成本。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較本地運算與交換時間。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for collective communication. Distributed work pays exchange costs. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare local compute and exchange time. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 比較本地運算與交換時間。
steps.observationEn: Compare local compute and exchange time.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：峰值 FLOP/s 可直接當作端到端訓練吞吐。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Peak FLOP/s equals end-to-end training throughput. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「集體通訊」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「分散工作需支付資料交換成本。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit collective communication two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 集體通訊的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 分散工作需支付資料交換成本。
knowledge.textEn: Distributed work pays exchange costs.

knowledge.title: 集體通訊的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 比較本地運算與交換時間。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Compare local compute and exchange time. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for collective communication and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Compare local compute and exchange time. Check the principle: Distributed work pays exchange costs. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.

steps.observationEn: Compare local compute and exchange time.

steps.check: 提交「集體通訊」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較本地運算與交換時間。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。

knowledge.textEn: Recalculate hypothetical effective peak. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

quiz.question: 本步審查「利用率」與整體「張量運算加速器」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing utilization within tensor-compute accelerators, which statement or check is supported?
options: BF16 與 FP16 有相同指數和尾數配置。
峰值 FLOP/s 可直接當作端到端訓練吞吐。
有效利用率包含形狀及等待損失。
optionsEn: BF16 and FP16 have identical exponent and mantissa layouts.
Peak FLOP/s equals end-to-end training throughput.
Useful utilization includes shape and wait losses.
quiz.explanation: 有效利用率包含形狀及等待損失。 重算假想陣列的有效峰值。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Useful utilization includes shape and wait losses. Recalculate hypothetical effective peak. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 利用率：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「重算假想陣列的有效峰值。」檢查「利用率」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for utilization using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「利用率」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：重算假想陣列的有效峰值。 核對「有效利用率包含形狀及等待損失。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for utilization and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Recalculate hypothetical effective peak. Check the principle: Useful utilization includes shape and wait losses. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 重算假想陣列的有效峰值。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate hypothetical effective peak.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：峰值 FLOP/s 可直接當作端到端訓練吞吐。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Peak FLOP/s equals end-to-end training throughput. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「利用率」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「重算假想陣列的有效峰值。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit utilization input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

steps.title: 輸入管線：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「輸入管線」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for input pipeline.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「輸入管線」的資料、控制與時間關係。預處理可能使加速器等待資料。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「分離讀取、轉換與運算耗時。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for input pipeline. Preprocessing can starve an accelerator. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Separate read, transform and compute times. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

steps.checkEn: Submit input pipeline two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

workedExample.title: 原創可重算假想案例
workedExample.text: 假想 128×128 MAC 陣列每週期每單元一 MAC、1 GHz，且 MAC 計兩 FLOP：峰值=128²×2×10⁹=32.768 TFLOP/s。若有效利用率 60%，為 19.661 TFLOP/s；不是任一真實 TPU 的產品規格。
workedExample.textEn: A hypothetical 128×128 MAC array at one MAC/cell/cycle and 1 GHz gives 32.768 TFLOP/s counting two FLOPs/MAC; assumed 60% utilization gives 19.661 TFLOP/s. This is not a real TPU specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、邊界與理想化前提；改變版本、工作負載、故障模型或資源條件後重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, boundaries and idealizations; recalculate after version, workload, fault-model or resource changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創算例；官方來源支援原理與背景，不是這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original assumed example; official sources support principles/context, not measurements of these numbers.

title: FPGA 資料流加速器
summary: 以HLS、串流管線與有限資源映射連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect hls, streaming pipelines and finite resource mapping through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: C 模型與硬體契約
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「C 模型與硬體契約」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop c models and hardware contracts through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 功能契約：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「功能契約」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for functional contract.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「功能契約」的資料、控制與時間關係。C 結果正確不代表硬體時序合格。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立輸入、輸出及完成定義。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for functional contract. Correct C output does not establish hardware timing. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Define input, output and completion. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 建立輸入、輸出及完成定義。
steps.observationEn: Define input, output and completion.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：II 與每筆資料延遲必定相等。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: II always equals per-item latency. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「功能契約」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「C 結果正確不代表硬體時序合格。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit functional contract two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 功能契約的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: C 結果正確不代表硬體時序合格。
knowledge.textEn: Correct C output does not establish hardware timing.

knowledge.title: 功能契約的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 建立輸入、輸出及完成定義。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Define input, output and completion. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設時脈 200 MHz、起始間隔 II=2 cycles，穩態每週期組輸出一筆 4 B，吞吐=100 M筆/s=400 MB/s。延遲 20 cycles=100 ns；短批次另計填充及排空。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 200 MHz, initiation interval II=2 cycles and one 4 B result per initiation. Steady throughput=100 Mitems/s=400 MB/s; 20-cycle latency=100 ns. Short batches also pay fill and drain.

quiz.question: 本步審查「功能契約」與整體「FPGA 資料流加速器」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing functional contract within fpga dataflow accelerators, which statement or check is supported?
options: C 結果正確不代表硬體時序合格。
II 與每筆資料延遲必定相等。
迴圈展開後記憶體埠數不再重要。
optionsEn: Correct C output does not establish hardware timing.
II always equals per-item latency.
Memory ports cease to matter after loop unrolling.
quiz.explanation: C 結果正確不代表硬體時序合格。 建立輸入、輸出及完成定義。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Correct C output does not establish hardware timing. Define input, output and completion. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 功能契約：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「建立輸入、輸出及完成定義。」檢查「功能契約」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for functional contract using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「功能契約」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：建立輸入、輸出及完成定義。 核對「C 結果正確不代表硬體時序合格。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for functional contract and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Define input, output and completion. Check the principle: Correct C output does not establish hardware timing. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 建立輸入、輸出及完成定義。
steps.observationEn: Define input, output and completion.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：II 與每筆資料延遲必定相等。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: II always equals per-item latency. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「功能契約」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「建立輸入、輸出及完成定義。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit functional contract input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for interface handshake. Valid and ready jointly determine transfers. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Enumerate stalls and continuous transfers. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 枚舉暫停與連續傳輸時序。
steps.observationEn: Enumerate stalls and continuous transfers.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：迴圈展開後記憶體埠數不再重要。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Memory ports cease to matter after loop unrolling. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「介面握手」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「有效與就緒共同決定資料轉移。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit interface handshake two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 介面握手的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 有效與就緒共同決定資料轉移。
knowledge.textEn: Valid and ready jointly determine transfers.

knowledge.title: 介面握手的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 枚舉暫停與連續傳輸時序。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Enumerate stalls and continuous transfers. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

quiz.question: 本步審查「介面握手」與整體「FPGA 資料流加速器」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？

options: 有效與就緒共同決定資料轉移。

迴圈展開後記憶體埠數不再重要。

quiz.explanationEn: Valid and ready jointly determine transfers. Enumerate stalls and continuous transfers. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 介面握手：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「枚舉暫停與連續傳輸時序。」檢查「介面握手」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
