steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「介面握手」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：枚舉暫停與連續傳輸時序。 核對「有效與就緒共同決定資料轉移。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for interface handshake and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Enumerate stalls and continuous transfers. Check the principle: Valid and ready jointly determine transfers. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 枚舉暫停與連續傳輸時序。
steps.observationEn: Enumerate stalls and continuous transfers.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：迴圈展開後記憶體埠數不再重要。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Memory ports cease to matter after loop unrolling. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「介面握手」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「枚舉暫停與連續傳輸時序。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit interface handshake input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

title: 片上網路路由器
summary: 以Flit、虛擬通道與可證明路由連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect flits, virtual channels and verifiable routing through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「拓撲與封包化」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop topology and packetization through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 拓撲座標：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「拓撲座標」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for topology coordinates. Mesh links determine hops and bisection bandwidth. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw a 4×4 mesh and count farthest hops. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

knowledge.text: 假設 128-bit flit、1 GHz、每週期一 flit，單向鏈路原始速率=16 GB/s。64 B 封包不計標頭需四 flit；四跳每跳 2 cycles 的空載路由延遲 8 ns，序列化另計。

steps.title: 正確性驗收：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「正確性驗收」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「正確性驗收」的資料、控制與時間關係。無丟包不代表無重複或順序正確。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「檢查序號、計數與交付順序。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for correctness acceptance. No loss does not imply no duplication or correct order. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check sequences, counts and delivery order. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 檢查序號、計數與交付順序。
steps.observationEn: Check sequences, counts and delivery order.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：鏈路峰值可直接當作全部端點吞吐。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Peak link rate equals total endpoint throughput. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

steps.checkEn: Submit correctness acceptance two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設 128-bit flit、1 GHz、每週期一 flit，單向鏈路原始速率=16 GB/s。64 B 封包不計標頭需四 flit；四跳每跳 2 cycles 的空載路由延遲 8 ns，序列化另計。

steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for correctness acceptance and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Check sequences, counts and delivery order. Check the principle: No loss does not imply no duplication or correct order. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.

steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Peak link rate equals total endpoint throughput. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「正確性驗收」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「檢查序號、計數與交付順序。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. steps.objective: 用「畫 ACT、READ、PRE 的時程。」檢查「啟動與預充」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for activate and precharge using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「啟動與預充」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：畫 ACT、READ、PRE 的時程。 核對「開列與關列需遵守時序間隔。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for activate and precharge and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Draw ACT, READ and PRE timing. Check the principle: Opening and closing rows obey timing intervals. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 畫 ACT、READ、PRE 的時程。
steps.observationEn: Draw ACT, READ and PRE timing.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：ECC 可更正任何位元數的錯誤。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: ECC corrects arbitrarily many bit errors. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「啟動與預充」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「畫 ACT、READ、PRE 的時程。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit activate and precharge input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

knowledge.title: 啟動與預充的原理與邊界
knowledge.titleEn: Activate and precharge principle and boundaries
knowledge.text: 開列與關列需遵守時序間隔。
knowledge.textEn: Opening and closing rows obey timing intervals.

knowledge.title: 啟動與預充的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 畫 ACT、READ、PRE 的時程。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Draw ACT, READ and PRE timing. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

quiz.question: 本步審查「啟動與預充」與整體「記憶體控制器與 ECC」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing activate and precharge within memory controllers and ecc, which statement or check is supported?
options: 畫 ACT、READ、PRE 的時程。
ECC 可更正任何位元數的錯誤。
6400 MT/s 代表每秒 6400 百萬完整記憶體命令。
optionsEn: Draw ACT, READ and PRE timing.
ECC corrects arbitrarily many bit errors.
6400 MT/s means 6400 million full memory commands per second.
quiz.explanation: 開列與關列需遵守時序間隔。 畫 ACT、READ、PRE 的時程。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Opening and closing rows obey timing intervals. Draw ACT, READ and PRE timing. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: Bank 平行：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「Bank 平行」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for bank parallelism.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Bank 平行」的資料、控制與時間關係。不同 bank 可重疊部分命令工作。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較單 bank 與交錯存取。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for bank parallelism. Banks can overlap some command work. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare one-bank and interleaved accesses. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 比較單 bank 與交錯存取。
steps.observationEn: Compare one-bank and interleaved accesses.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：6400 MT/s 代表每秒 6400 百萬完整記憶體命令。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: 6400 MT/s means 6400 million full memory commands per second. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「Bank 平行」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「不同 bank 可重疊部分命令工作。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit bank parallelism two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、邊界與理想化前提；改變版本、工作負載、故障模型或資源條件後重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, boundaries and idealizations; recalculate after version, workload, fault-model or resource changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創算例；官方來源支援原理與背景，不是這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original assumed example; official sources support principles/context, not measurements of these numbers.

title: 嵌入式即時作業系統
summary: 以即時排程、同步與可界定延遲連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect real-time scheduling, synchronization and bounded latency through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: 時間契約與任務
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「時間契約與任務」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop timing contracts and tasks through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: Deadline 契約：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「Deadline 契約」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Deadline 契約」的資料、控制與時間關係。硬 deadline 與平均延遲要求不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「為假想控制迴路標示到期點。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for deadline contracts. Hard deadlines differ from average latency goals. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Mark deadlines for a modeled control loop. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 為假想控制迴路標示到期點。
steps.observationEn: Mark deadlines for a modeled control loop.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：優先權繼承能消除所有阻塞時間。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Priority inheritance removes every blocking interval. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

knowledge.textEn: Hard deadlines differ from average latency goals.

knowledge.title: Deadline 契約的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 為假想控制迴路標示到期點。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設單核心週期任務 C/T 分別 1/5 ms、2/10 ms、2/20 ms，U=0.5。三任務 RM 充分界=3(2^(1/3)−1)≈0.7798，因此在獨立、可搶佔、deadline=period 等前提可通過此充分測試；不是 Zephyr 保證。
knowledge.textEn: For one core with periodic C/T=1/5, 2/10 and 2/20 ms, U=0.5. The three-task RM sufficient bound is 0.7798, under independent, preemptible tasks with deadlines equal to periods; not a Zephyr guarantee.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

workedExample.title: 原創可重算假想案例
workedExample.text: 假設單核心週期任務 C/T 分別 1/5 ms、2/10 ms、2/20 ms，U=0.5。三任務 RM 充分界=3(2^(1/3)−1)≈0.7798，因此在獨立、可搶佔、deadline=period 等前提可通過此充分測試；不是 Zephyr 保證。
workedExample.textEn: For one core with periodic C/T=1/5, 2/10 and 2/20 ms, U=0.5. The three-task RM sufficient bound is 0.7798, under independent, preemptible tasks with deadlines equal to periods; not a Zephyr guarantee.
workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、邊界與理想化前提；改變版本、工作負載、故障模型或資源條件後重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, boundaries and idealizations; recalculate after version, workload, fault-model or resource changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創算例；官方來源支援原理與背景，不是這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original assumed example; official sources support principles/context, not measurements of these numbers.

title: 安全啟動與韌體信任鏈
titleEn: Secure boot and firmware chains of trust
summary: 以可信根、映像驗證與可復原更新連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。 原有步驟及進度識別完整保留。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect roots of trust, image verification and recoverable updates through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation. Existing steps and progress identities are preserved.

labelsEn: Root of trust and boot graph

stages.title: 信任架構
stages.description: 盤點啟動路徑與授權，不把所有韌體保護都等同 UEFI Secure Boot。
stages.descriptionEn: Inventory boot paths and authority without equating all firmware protection with UEFI Secure Boot.

steps.title: 盤點啟動元件與信任邊界
steps.titleEn: Inventory boot components and trust boundaries
steps.objective: 畫出韌體、載入器、核心及每次驗證先於執行的邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Map firmware, loader and kernel with verification boundaries before execution.
steps.instruction: 在隔離的紙上模型排列信任根、平台韌體、UEFI 載入器與作業系統核心。為每次交接標明驗證者、被驗證資料與失敗處置；把硬體韌體保護與 UEFI 映像政策分開。
steps.instructionEn: In an isolated paper model, order the root of trust, platform firmware, UEFI loader and OS kernel. Label verifier, verified data and failure handling at each handoff, separating firmware protection from UEFI image policy.
steps.observation: 沒有驗證的交接點，不能只因前一段可信就宣稱後一段可信。
steps.observationEn: An unverified handoff does not become trusted merely because its predecessor is trusted.
steps.failure: 把「已開啟 Secure Boot」視為所有裝置韌體都受保護，會漏掉範圍外元件。
steps.failureEn: Treating enabled Secure Boot as protection for every device firmware overlooks components outside its scope.
steps.check: 每條執行箭頭前都有對應驗證或明確列出的架構假設。
steps.checkEn: Precede every execution edge with verification or an explicitly recorded architectural assumption.

knowledge.title: 信任鏈
knowledge.text: 信任需要逐段建立，並以受保護的起點作基礎。
knowledge.textEn: Trust is established across successive stages from a protected starting point.

knowledge.title: 保護範圍
knowledge.text: UEFI 映像驗證與平台全部韌體的完整性是相關但不同的範圍。
knowledge.textEn: UEFI image verification and integrity of all platform firmware are related but distinct scopes.

quiz.question: 載入器可信，是否足以直接執行任何未驗證核心？
quiz.questionEn: Does a trusted loader justify executing any unverified kernel?
options: 不足，下一段仍需依其信任政策驗證。
足夠，前一段可信就等同所有後續輸入都受授權。
足夠，只要核心雜湊由該核心自己宣告即可。
optionsEn: No; the next stage still needs verification under its trust policy.
Yes; trust in the previous stage authorizes all subsequent inputs.
Yes; the kernel only needs to declare its own hash.
quiz.explanation: 不足，下一段仍需依其信任政策驗證。 信任需要逐段建立，並以受保護的起點作基礎。
quiz.explanationEn: No; the next stage still needs verification under its trust policy. Trust is established across successive stages from a protected starting point.

steps.title: 定義信任根與受保護狀態
steps.titleEn: Define roots of trust and protected state
steps.objective: 辨認不能由待驗證軟體自行改寫的信任依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify trust evidence that unverified software cannot rewrite at will.
steps.instruction: 在架構圖標出驗證程式、信任金鑰、版本狀態與復原根。對每項提出「誰能修改」及「修改如何授權」兩個問題，使用假設權限表而不操作真實韌體。
steps.instructionEn: Mark verifier code, trust keys, version state and recovery roots. For each, ask who can modify it and how changes are authorized, using a hypothetical permission table rather than modifying real firmware.
steps.observation: 若被驗證映像也能任意替換驗證金鑰，信任會形成循環。
steps.observationEn: If the image under review can freely replace its verification key, trust becomes circular.
steps.failure: 僅把金鑰檔案命名為 root 並不提供保護；需說明保護機制。
steps.failureEn: Naming a key file root provides no protection; explain the protection mechanism.
steps.check: 每個信任依據都有保護位置、修改權限與授權路徑。
steps.checkEn: Give each trust anchor a protected location, modification authority and authorization path.

knowledge.title: 信任起點
knowledge.text: 信任根的可靠性不能完全依賴它所驗證的軟體。
knowledge.textEn: A root’s reliability cannot depend entirely on the software it verifies.

knowledge.title: 受控更新
knowledge.text: 可更新的信任資料仍需要明確、受驗證的變更規則。
knowledge.textEn: Updatable trust data still need explicit authenticated change rules.

quiz.question: 若未驗證映像可以替換自己的信任金鑰，問題是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What is wrong if an unverified image can replace its own trust key?
options: 只要更換後的金鑰格式正確，就不影響安全。
它可自行建立接受自己的依據，破壞信任邊界。
金鑰可修改代表系統自動具備安全更新能力。
optionsEn: A correctly formatted replacement key cannot affect security.
It can manufacture its own acceptance basis, breaking the trust boundary.
A modifiable key automatically provides secure update capability.
quiz.explanation: 它可自行建立接受自己的依據，破壞信任邊界。 信任根的可靠性不能完全依賴它所驗證的軟體。
quiz.explanationEn: It can manufacture its own acceptance basis, breaking the trust boundary. A root’s reliability cannot depend entirely on the software it verifies.

steps.title: 區分 PK、KEK、db 與 dbx
steps.titleEn: Separate PK, KEK, db and dbx
steps.objective: 把平台所有權、政策更新與映像允許權限分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate platform ownership, policy updates and image authorization.
steps.instruction: 建立四張權限卡，分別對應平台金鑰、金鑰交換金鑰、允許資料庫與禁止資料庫。用箭頭表示誰能授權更新哪個資料庫，另畫執行映像的判斷路徑。
steps.instructionEn: Create cards for PK, KEK, the allowed database and the forbidden database. Draw policy-update authorization arrows separately from the path used to decide whether an image executes.
steps.observation: 可以授權更新資料庫的金鑰，不等於自動允許所有由它簽署的執行映像。
steps.observationEn: A key authorized to update a database does not automatically authorize every executable it signs.
steps.failure: 把 PK 當成每個作業系統映像唯一簽署者，會混淆管理權與執行權。
steps.failureEn: Treating PK as the sole signer of every OS image confuses policy management with execution authorization.
steps.check: 能用一張圖區分金鑰管理與映像驗證兩條路徑。
steps.checkEn: Distinguish key-management and image-verification paths in one diagram.

knowledge.title: 權限分工
knowledge.text: UEFI 政策將平台控制、政策更新及映像信任資料分成不同角色。
knowledge.textEn: UEFI policy separates platform control, policy updates and image trust data into distinct roles.

knowledge.title: 最小授權
knowledge.text: 一種權限不能被推定為所有其他權限。
knowledge.textEn: One form of authority must not be assumed to grant every other authority.

quiz.question: KEK 的主要角色較接近哪個描述？
quiz.questionEn: Which description best matches the role of KEK?
options: 直接提供所有作業系統核心的執行允許清單。
記錄裝置目前韌體的量測雜湊。
授權相關安全啟動資料庫的更新。
optionsEn: Directly serving as the execution allow list for every OS kernel.
Recording measured hashes of the current device firmware.
Authorizing updates to the relevant Secure Boot databases.
quiz.explanation: 授權相關安全啟動資料庫的更新。 UEFI 政策將平台控制、政策更新及映像信任資料分成不同角色。
quiz.explanationEn: Authorizing updates to the relevant Secure Boot databases. UEFI policy separates platform control, policy updates and image trust data into distinct roles.

steps.title: 比較雜湊完整性與簽章授權
steps.titleEn: Compare hash integrity and signature authorization
steps.objective: 區分內容識別與可信發布者的判定。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish content identification from trusted-publisher authorization.
steps.instruction: 在紙上為原始映像與修改一位元的映像各指定不同雜湊，再加入可信與未知簽署者兩種卡片。分別判斷內容是否一致、簽章是否可驗證及簽署者是否受政策信任。
steps.instructionEn: Assign distinct hypothetical hashes to an original image and a one-bit modification, then add trusted and unknown signer cards. Separately judge content integrity, signature verification and policy trust in the signer.
steps.observation: 可算出雜湊，不代表該雜湊來自可信來源；簽章可驗證也仍需政策授權。
steps.observationEn: Computing a hash does not establish its trusted origin; a verifiable signature still needs policy authorization.
steps.failure: 從同一未知來源下載映像與雜湊，不能單靠兩者一致建立發布者信任。
steps.failureEn: An image and hash from the same unknown source do not establish publisher trust simply by matching.
steps.check: 每個接受結論同時說明內容驗證與信任來源。
steps.checkEn: Explain both integrity verification and trust provenance for each acceptance decision.

knowledge.title: 不同問題
knowledge.text: 雜湊描述內容，簽章與信任政策協助判斷授權來源。
knowledge.textEn: Hashes characterize content; signatures and trust policy help determine authorized origin.

knowledge.title: 私鑰保管
knowledge.text: 發布簽署私鑰不應隨待驗證映像交付給裝置作一般資料。
knowledge.textEn: A release-signing private key should not be distributed as ordinary data alongside the image it authenticates.

quiz.question: 映像和未知網站提供的雜湊一致，能證明什麼？
quiz.questionEn: An image matches a hash from an unknown website. What does that prove?
options: 兩者在內容識別上相符，仍未建立可信發布者。
已證明該網站是受授權的韌體發布者。
已證明此版本符合目前的撤銷與防回滾政策。
optionsEn: They agree as content identifiers, but a trusted publisher is not established.
It proves the website is an authorized firmware publisher.
It proves compliance with current revocation and rollback policies.
quiz.explanation: 兩者在內容識別上相符，仍未建立可信發布者。 雜湊描述內容，簽章與信任政策協助判斷授權來源。
quiz.explanationEn: They agree as content identifiers, but a trusted publisher is not established. Hashes characterize content; signatures and trust policy help determine authorized origin.

stages.title: 驗證與更新
stages.description: 推演允許、拒絕、模式與版本政策的不同效果。
stages.descriptionEn: Model allow/deny decisions, modes and version policies separately.

steps.title: 推演允許與撤銷的判斷順序
steps.objective: 理解明確撤銷不能被一般允許條目蓋過。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand why explicit revocation cannot be overridden by ordinary allowance.
steps.instruction: 建立三個基本案例：受信任且未撤銷、未知簽署者、映像雜湊明確列入 dbx。逐一走過驗證流程，在最後一例保留原本受信任的簽署者以檢查撤銷效果。
steps.instructionEn: Create basic cases for a trusted unrevoked image, an unknown signer and an image hash explicitly listed in dbx. Keep the last image’s signer otherwise trusted to test revocation independently.
steps.observation: 曾經可啟動的映像，在政策撤銷後可能需要被拒絕。
steps.observationEn: A previously bootable image may need rejection after policy revocation.
steps.failure: 把成功驗證簽章當成唯一通行證，會漏掉禁止資料庫的限制。
steps.failureEn: Treating signature verification as the only pass condition overlooks forbidden-database restrictions.
steps.check: 三個案例有清楚接受或拒絕結果，並標出所使用的政策版本。
steps.checkEn: Record a clear allow/deny outcome and policy revision for each case.

knowledge.title: 撤銷的用途
knowledge.text: 有效簽章不代表映像永遠適合被信任。
knowledge.textEn: A valid signature does not make an image suitable for trust forever.

knowledge.title: 政策版本
knowledge.text: 同一映像的判斷可因信任資料更新而改變。
knowledge.textEn: The decision on one image can change when trust data are updated.

quiz.question: 映像簽章有效，但其雜湊明確列入 dbx 的基本案例應如何處理？
quiz.questionEn: A signature is valid but the image hash is explicitly in dbx. What should this basic case do?
options: 忽略 dbx，因為簽章曾經有效。
依禁止政策拒絕該映像。
把 dbx 當作允許清單。
optionsEn: Ignore dbx because the signature was once valid.
Reject the image under the forbidden policy.
Treat dbx as an allow list.
quiz.explanation: 依禁止政策拒絕該映像。 有效簽章不代表映像永遠適合被信任。
quiz.explanationEn: Reject the image under the forbidden policy. A valid signature does not make an image suitable for trust forever.

steps.title: 區分設定模式與強制驗證狀態
steps.objective: 避免把政策已寫入誤當安全啟動已強制執行。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid equating enrolled policy data with active enforcement.
steps.instruction: 使用假設狀態表記錄 SetupMode、SecureBoot 與已配置信任資料。比較初始佈建、正常強制驗證及維修例外三種情境；只作模型判讀，不變更本機設定。
steps.instructionEn: Use a hypothetical state table for SetupMode, SecureBoot and enrolled trust data. Compare provisioning, normal enforcement and a maintenance exception without changing this device’s settings.
steps.observation: 有金鑰資料與目前實際強制驗證，是需要分開確認的證據。
steps.observationEn: Presence of key data and current verification enforcement require separate confirmation.
steps.failure: 僅截取一張金鑰清單而不記錄執行狀態，可能錯認保護已生效。
steps.failureEn: A key-list screenshot without enforcement state can falsely imply protection is active.
steps.check: 能說明每個情境的權限和驗證狀態，例外有明確回復條件。
steps.checkEn: Explain authority and enforcement for each case, with explicit restoration conditions for exceptions.

knowledge.title: 狀態與資料
knowledge.text: 安全政策資料存在，不代表所有運作模式都相同。
knowledge.textEn: Security-policy data can exist while operating modes differ.

knowledge.title: 佈建邊界
knowledge.text: 初始化與部署後的變更規則需要明確區別。
knowledge.textEn: Initial provisioning and post-deployment change rules must be distinguished.

quiz.question: 看到 db 中有信任憑證，是否足以證明目前強制驗證已啟用？
quiz.questionEn: Does a trusted certificate in db prove enforcement is currently enabled?
options: 足夠，任何資料存在都會自動強制執行。
足夠，模式變數沒有用途。
不足，還需確認相關運作狀態。
optionsEn: Yes; any stored data automatically enforce themselves.
Yes; mode variables have no purpose.
No; the relevant operating state must also be confirmed.
quiz.explanation: 不足，還需確認相關運作狀態。 安全政策資料存在，不代表所有運作模式都相同。
quiz.explanationEn: No; the relevant operating state must also be confirmed. Security-policy data can exist while operating modes differ.

steps.title: 驗證先行與執行交接
steps.objective: 找出先執行後檢查的邏輯缺口。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the flaw in checking code after executing it.
steps.instruction: 將「讀入、驗證、政策判定、執行」排成狀態機，為失敗分支指定停止或可信復原。再故意交換驗證與執行的位置，說明這會讓哪個信任假設失效。
steps.instructionEn: Arrange read, verify, policy decision and execute into a state machine, with stop or trusted recovery on failure. Swap verification and execution deliberately and identify the broken trust assumption.
steps.observation: 記錄已執行程式的雜湊，不等於事先阻止未授權程式執行。
steps.observationEn: Recording a hash of executed code is not the same as preventing unauthorized execution beforehand.
steps.failure: 只有成功路徑而無失敗分支的流程圖，不能描述安全啟動的完整決策。
steps.failureEn: A success-only flowchart cannot describe the full secure-boot decision.
steps.check: 每個失敗狀態都不會直接跳到未驗證映像執行。
steps.checkEn: No failure state directly transfers control to an unverified image.

knowledge.title: 時間順序
knowledge.text: 驗證要保護執行交接，就必須在該交接前產生有效決定。
knowledge.textEn: Verification protects an execution handoff only when it establishes a valid decision before that handoff.

knowledge.title: 紀錄與阻擋
knowledge.text: 量測或稽核紀錄可補充證據，但不能假定等同阻擋機制。
knowledge.textEn: Measurement or audit records add evidence but must not be assumed equivalent to blocking.

quiz.question: 先執行映像、再驗證簽章的核心問題是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What is the central flaw in executing an image before verifying its signature?
options: 未授權內容可能已取得執行機會。
只影響開機速度，不影響未授權內容的執行。
事後驗證失敗可自動撤回所有已發生的執行效果。
optionsEn: Unauthorized content may already have executed.
It affects boot speed but not unauthorized execution.
Failed post-execution verification automatically reverses all prior execution effects.
quiz.explanation: 未授權內容可能已取得執行機會。 驗證要保護執行交接，就必須在該交接前產生有效決定。
quiz.explanationEn: Unauthorized content may already have executed. Verification protects an execution handoff only when it establishes a valid decision before that handoff.

steps.title: 分開更新授權與防回滾政策
steps.titleEn: Separate update authorization from rollback policy
steps.objective: 理解舊的合法簽章仍可能對應不應再用的版本。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand that an old valid signature can identify an unsuitable version.
steps.instruction: 建立三個已簽署韌體版本的模型，其中一個已被產品政策淘汰。分別檢查簽署授權、映像完整性與版本下限，並註明防回滾是另外設計的機制。
steps.instructionEn: Model three signed firmware versions, one retired by product policy. Check signing authority, integrity and a minimum-version rule separately, explicitly treating rollback resistance as an additional mechanism.
steps.observation: 簽章是否有效與版本是否符合目前政策，可以得到不同答案。
steps.observationEn: Signature validity and current version-policy compliance can yield different answers.
steps.failure: 不能宣稱一般 UEFI Secure Boot 自動實作所有產品的版本計數器。
steps.failureEn: Do not claim generic UEFI Secure Boot automatically implements every product’s version counter.
steps.check: 更新表分別列出驗證、授權與版本決策，且描述例外復原的限制。
steps.checkEn: Separate verification, authorization and version decisions, including limits on recovery exceptions.

knowledge.title: 合法但過舊
knowledge.text: 映像曾由可信者發布，不代表今天仍應允許回復使用。
knowledge.textEn: A trusted past release is not necessarily acceptable to restore today.

knowledge.title: 版本狀態保護
knowledge.text: 若採用防回滾，最低版本等政策狀態也要受到保護。
knowledge.textEn: Rollback resistance also requires protection of policy state such as a minimum version.

quiz.question: 一個舊版簽章仍有效，最合理的下一步是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: An old version still has a valid signature. What is the reasonable next check?
options: 只檢查簽章數學上有效，就允許任何歷史版本。
確認目前版本與撤銷政策是否仍允許。
只比較版本字串長度，不檢查受保護的版本政策。
optionsEn: Permit every historical version if its signature is mathematically valid.
Check whether current version and revocation policies still permit it.
Compare version-string length rather than protected version policy.
quiz.explanation: 確認目前版本與撤銷政策是否仍允許。 映像曾由可信者發布，不代表今天仍應允許回復使用。
quiz.explanationEn: Check whether current version and revocation policies still permit it. A trusted past release is not necessarily acceptable to restore today.

stages.title: 復原與發布
stages.description: 以失敗案例與金鑰變更檢查系統是否仍可可信復原。
stages.descriptionEn: Use failures and key transitions to verify that trusted recovery remains possible.

steps.title: 設計金鑰輪替與撤銷順序
steps.titleEn: Plan key rotation and revocation order
steps.objective: 維持新舊發布與復原映像的相容過渡。
steps.objectiveEn: Maintain a compatible transition for releases and recovery images.
steps.instruction: 在時間線放置新增信任金鑰、更新啟動與復原映像、驗證部署結果及撤銷舊信任四件事。用離線或延遲更新裝置的案例，找出會使裝置無可信映像可啟動的排序。
steps.instructionEn: Place new trust enrollment, boot and recovery image updates, deployment verification and old-trust revocation on a timeline. Include delayed or offline devices to find sequences that leave no trusted bootable image.
steps.observation: 只更新日常啟動映像而忘記復原媒體，可能留下未來復原失效。
steps.observationEn: Updating the normal boot image but forgetting recovery media can create a later recovery failure.
steps.failure: 過早撤銷而沒有可用替代映像，不能靠重啟次數修正。
steps.failureEn: Premature revocation without a usable replacement cannot be repaired by repeated restarts.
steps.check: 輪替計畫涵蓋試點、延遲裝置、復原媒體及明確停止條件。
steps.checkEn: Cover pilot devices, delayed devices, recovery media and explicit stop criteria.

knowledge.title: 過渡相容性
knowledge.text: 金鑰政策與可啟動映像必須以相容順序更新。
knowledge.textEn: Key policy and bootable images must be updated in a compatible order.

knowledge.title: 簽署職責
knowledge.text: 發布、授權與私鑰保管職責應被明確分配。
knowledge.textEn: Release, authorization and private-key custody need explicit responsibility assignments.

quiz.question: 撤銷舊信任前，哪項檢查最直接避免無法啟動？
quiz.questionEn: Which check most directly avoids unbootable devices before old trust is revoked?
options: 只確認新金鑰已產生，不檢查裝置是否信任它。
只更新正常啟動映像，復原映像與輪替無關。
確認目標裝置與復原路徑已有受新政策接受的映像。
optionsEn: Confirm only that the new key exists, not whether devices trust it.
Update only normal boot images; recovery images are unrelated to rotation.
Confirm target devices and recovery paths have images accepted by the new policy.
quiz.explanation: 確認目標裝置與復原路徑已有受新政策接受的映像。 金鑰政策與可啟動映像必須以相容順序更新。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm target devices and recovery paths have images accepted by the new policy. Key policy and bootable images must be updated in a compatible order.

steps.title: 建立可信復原而非任意回退
steps.titleEn: Design trusted recovery rather than arbitrary fallback
steps.objective: 確保恢復可用性不破壞完整性。
steps.objectiveEn: Restore availability without abandoning integrity.
steps.instruction: 在狀態圖加入主映像損壞、更新中斷與復原映像不受信任三種案例。為每種指定可驗證的復原來源和失敗出口，不把「任意舊檔」當成保證成功的備份。
steps.instructionEn: Add cases for a corrupt primary image, interrupted update and untrusted recovery image. Specify an authenticated recovery source and failure exit for each rather than treating any old file as a guaranteed backup.
steps.observation: 復原映像本身及其授權路徑也需要保護。
steps.observationEn: Recovery images and their authorization path also need protection.
steps.failure: 為了開機而跳過復原驗證，可能把故障處理變成信任繞過。
steps.failureEn: Skipping recovery verification merely to boot can turn fault handling into a trust bypass.
steps.check: 每條復原路徑都說明信任依據、版本政策與失敗時的處置。
steps.checkEn: State the trust basis, version policy and failure handling for every recovery path.

knowledge.title: 韌性三部分
knowledge.text: 韌體韌性結合保護、偵測與可信復原。
knowledge.textEn: Firmware resilience combines protection, detection and trusted recovery.

knowledge.title: 可用性與完整性
knowledge.text: 恢復運作仍須保持授權與完整性，兩者不是互斥選項。
knowledge.textEn: Restoring operation should preserve authorization and integrity rather than discard them.

quiz.question: 主映像損壞時，哪種復原做法符合信任設計？
quiz.questionEn: Which recovery approach preserves trust after the primary image is corrupted?
options: 驗證復原映像和其授權，再依政策恢復。
執行第一個找到的未知映像。
把所有簽章檢查永久關閉。
optionsEn: Verify the recovery image and authorization, then recover under policy.
Execute the first unknown image found.
Permanently disable every signature check.
quiz.explanation: 驗證復原映像和其授權，再依政策恢復。 韌體韌性結合保護、偵測與可信復原。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify the recovery image and authorization, then recover under policy. Firmware resilience combines protection, detection and trusted recovery.

steps.title: 建立拒絕案例與中斷案例矩陣
steps.titleEn: Build rejection and interruption test cases
steps.objective: 證明失敗路徑也符合設計意圖。
steps.objectiveEn: Show that failure paths also meet the design intent.
steps.instruction: 只在隔離模型列出內容遭修改、未知簽署者、明確撤銷、過舊版本及更新中斷五種案例。對每例預先寫下預期結果，再記錄模型的實際決策與差異。
steps.instructionEn: In an isolated model only, list modified content, an unknown signer, explicit revocation, an obsolete version and interrupted update. Write expected outcomes before recording modeled decisions and discrepancies.
steps.observation: 成功啟動一次不能替代拒絕未授權內容的測試。
steps.observationEn: One successful boot cannot replace tests that reject unauthorized content.
steps.failure: 測試後才改寫預期值以符合結果，會使驗證失去意義。
steps.failureEn: Rewriting expectations afterward to match outcomes makes verification meaningless.
steps.check: 矩陣含預期、觀察、政策版本與差異處置，且不接觸生產裝置。
steps.checkEn: Include expected outcome, observation, policy revision and discrepancy handling without touching production devices.

knowledge.title: 負向測試
knowledge.text: 安全功能需要證明應拒絕的輸入被正確拒絕。
knowledge.textEn: A security function must demonstrate correct rejection of inputs that should be denied.

knowledge.title: 事先判據
knowledge.text: 先寫預期結果，才能辨認實作與設計的差異。
knowledge.textEn: Defining expected outcomes first makes implementation discrepancies visible.

quiz.question: 所有合法映像都能啟動，是否代表拒絕機制已驗證？
quiz.questionEn: All legitimate images boot. Does that verify the rejection mechanism?
options: 有，允許清單運作就能推定禁止清單正確。
沒有，仍須測試應拒絕的案例。
有，因為沒有發現啟動失敗就代表所有拒絕路徑正確。
optionsEn: Yes; a working allow list proves the deny list works.
No; cases that should be rejected still need testing.
Yes; no observed boot failures proves every rejection path correct.
quiz.explanation: 沒有，仍須測試應拒絕的案例。 安全功能需要證明應拒絕的輸入被正確拒絕。
quiz.explanationEn: No; cases that should be rejected still need testing. A security function must demonstrate correct rejection of inputs that should be denied.

steps.title: 交付發布清單與可稽核證據
steps.titleEn: Deliver release inventory and auditable evidence
steps.objective: 讓裝置狀態、信任政策與復原能力可追溯。
steps.objectiveEn: Make device state, trust policy and recovery capability traceable.
steps.instruction: 整理元件清單、信任角色、版本政策、測試矩陣與復原演練結果。為小批試點和大批部署各設一個停止條件，說明收到異常結果時如何保留證據與暫停推進。
steps.instructionEn: Assemble component inventory, trust roles, version policy, test matrix and recovery-exercise results. Define a stop criterion for pilot and wider rollout, preserving evidence and pausing progression on anomalies.
steps.observation: 文件應能回答哪台裝置、哪版政策、哪個映像與哪次驗證，而不只寫「安全」。
steps.observationEn: Records should identify device, policy revision, image and verification event rather than simply say secure.
steps.failure: 分享稽核資料時不應把簽署私鑰混入交付附件。
steps.failureEn: Audit deliverables must not accidentally include signing private keys.
steps.check: 交付包包含可讀證據與限制，沒有宣稱模型測試等同整個平台安全認證。
steps.checkEn: Deliver readable evidence and limitations without equating model tests with complete platform certification.

knowledge.title: 可追溯發布
knowledge.text: 發布決定需要連接映像身分、授權與實際驗證結果。
knowledge.textEn: Release decisions should connect image identity, authorization and observed verification results.

knowledge.title: 範圍誠實
knowledge.text: 啟動信任是系統防護的一部分，不涵蓋所有執行期漏洞。
knowledge.textEn: Boot trust is one part of system protection and does not cover every runtime vulnerability.

quiz.question: 哪份紀錄最能支持可信交付？
quiz.questionEn: Which record best supports a trustworthy handoff?
options: 只有一張成功開機畫面，未記錄政策與映像版本。
只有映像雜湊清單，未連接裝置、授權與復原測試。
裝置、映像、政策版本、測試結果與復原限制的對應表。
optionsEn: Only a successful-boot screenshot with no policy or image revision.
Only image hashes without links to devices, authorization or recovery tests.
A mapping of devices, images, policy revisions, test results and recovery limitations.
quiz.explanation: 裝置、映像、政策版本、測試結果與復原限制的對應表。 發布決定需要連接映像身分、授權與實際驗證結果。
quiz.explanationEn: A mapping of devices, images, policy revisions, test results and recovery limitations. Release decisions should connect image identity, authorization and observed verification results.

stages.title: 可信根與啟動圖
stages.titleEn: Root of trust and boot graph
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「可信根與啟動圖」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop root of trust and boot graph through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 信任起點：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「信任起點」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for trust anchor.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「信任起點」的資料、控制與時間關係。驗證公鑰本身需受可信邊界保護。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「標出可寫與唯讀儲存。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for trust anchor. Verification keys themselves need protection. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Mark writable and read-only storage. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 標出可寫與唯讀儲存。
steps.observationEn: Mark writable and read-only storage.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有簽過章的舊映像皆可安全回退。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Every signed old image is safe to roll back. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「信任起點」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「驗證公鑰本身需受可信邊界保護。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit trust anchor two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 信任起點的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 驗證公鑰本身需受可信邊界保護。
knowledge.textEn: Verification keys themselves need protection.

knowledge.title: 信任起點的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 標出可寫與唯讀儲存。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Mark writable and read-only storage. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設驗證 32 MiB 映像，雜湊持續速率 400 MiB/s，僅雜湊下界=80 ms；另假定兩次簽章驗證各 5 ms，總 90 ms，未含讀取與初始化。不是任何裝置實測。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a 32 MiB image hashed at sustained 400 MiB/s: hashing lower bound=80 ms. Two assumed 5 ms signature checks give 90 ms total, excluding reads and initialization; not a device measurement.

quiz.question: 本步審查「信任起點」與整體「安全啟動與韌體信任鏈」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing trust anchor within secure boot and firmware chains of trust, which statement or check is supported?
options: 驗證公鑰本身需受可信邊界保護。
所有簽過章的舊映像皆可安全回退。
Measured boot 必定拒絕不可信映像。
optionsEn: Verification keys themselves need protection.
Every signed old image is safe to roll back.
Measured boot necessarily rejects untrusted images.
quiz.explanation: 驗證公鑰本身需受可信邊界保護。 標出可寫與唯讀儲存。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Verification keys themselves need protection. Mark writable and read-only storage. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 信任起點：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「標出可寫與唯讀儲存。」檢查「信任起點」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for trust anchor using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「信任起點」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：標出可寫與唯讀儲存。 核對「驗證公鑰本身需受可信邊界保護。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for trust anchor and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Mark writable and read-only storage. Check the principle: Verification keys themselves need protection. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 標出可寫與唯讀儲存。
steps.observationEn: Mark writable and read-only storage.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有簽過章的舊映像皆可安全回退。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Every signed old image is safe to roll back. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「信任起點」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「標出可寫與唯讀儲存。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit trust anchor input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

knowledge.title: 信任起點的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 驗證公鑰本身需受可信邊界保護。
knowledge.textEn: Verification keys themselves need protection.

knowledge.title: 信任起點的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 標出可寫與唯讀儲存。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Mark writable and read-only storage. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.text: 假設驗證 32 MiB 映像，雜湊持續速率 400 MiB/s，僅雜湊下界=80 ms；另假定兩次簽章驗證各 5 ms，總 90 ms，未含讀取與初始化。不是任何裝置實測。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a 32 MiB image hashed at sustained 400 MiB/s: hashing lower bound=80 ms. Two assumed 5 ms signature checks give 90 ms total, excluding reads and initialization; not a device measurement.

quiz.question: 本步審查「信任起點」與整體「安全啟動與韌體信任鏈」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing trust anchor within secure boot and firmware chains of trust, which statement or check is supported?
options: 所有簽過章的舊映像皆可安全回退。
標出可寫與唯讀儲存。
Measured boot 必定拒絕不可信映像。
optionsEn: Every signed old image is safe to roll back.
Mark writable and read-only storage.
Measured boot necessarily rejects untrusted images.
quiz.explanation: 驗證公鑰本身需受可信邊界保護。 標出可寫與唯讀儲存。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Verification keys themselves need protection. Mark writable and read-only storage. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 啟動序列：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「啟動序列」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for boot sequence.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「啟動序列」的資料、控制與時間關係。每一載入階段可形成新的驗證邊界。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「列出 ROM 到應用的關係。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for boot sequence. Each loading stage creates a verification boundary. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: List ROM-to-application relationships. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 列出 ROM 到應用的關係。
steps.observationEn: List ROM-to-application relationships.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：Measured boot 必定拒絕不可信映像。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Measured boot necessarily rejects untrusted images. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「啟動序列」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「每一載入階段可形成新的驗證邊界。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit boot sequence two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 啟動序列的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 每一載入階段可形成新的驗證邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Each loading stage creates a verification boundary.

knowledge.title: 啟動序列的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 列出 ROM 到應用的關係。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: List ROM-to-application relationships. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

quiz.question: 本步審查「啟動序列」與整體「安全啟動與韌體信任鏈」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing boot sequence within secure boot and firmware chains of trust, which statement or check is supported?
options: 所有簽過章的舊映像皆可安全回退。
Measured boot 必定拒絕不可信映像。
每一載入階段可形成新的驗證邊界。
optionsEn: Every signed old image is safe to roll back.
Measured boot necessarily rejects untrusted images.
Each loading stage creates a verification boundary.
quiz.explanation: 每一載入階段可形成新的驗證邊界。 列出 ROM 到應用的關係。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Each loading stage creates a verification boundary. List ROM-to-application relationships. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 啟動序列：實驗與驗證

steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for digest integrity and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Flip one bit in a fictional image. Check the principle: Digest checks need trusted expected values. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 用虛構映像更改一位元。
steps.observationEn: Flip one bit in a fictional image.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有簽過章的舊映像皆可安全回退。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Every signed old image is safe to roll back. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「摘要完整性」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「用虛構映像更改一位元。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit digest integrity input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

knowledge.title: 摘要完整性的原理與邊界

knowledge.title: 摘要完整性的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 用虛構映像更改一位元。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。

steps.title: 防回退：原理與架構

steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for rollback resistance.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for rollback resistance. Old valid signatures do not establish freshness. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare signatures and monotonic-version policy. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。

Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check compiler target and kernel configuration. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

knowledge.text: 假設 RV64 教學配置要求 2 MiB 對齊，實體位置 0x80200000 除以 0x200000 無餘數；0x80300000 餘 1 MiB，需調整。16 MiB 保留區佔 512 MiB RAM 的 3.125%；依選定啟動方式重查規格。

steps.observation: 定位最後可見啟動階段。

steps.title: 主控臺：實驗與驗證

steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for console and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Locate the last visible boot phase. Check the principle: Early and full console paths differ. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.

title: 微核心作業系統架構
summary: 以能力權限、IPC 與小可信計算基連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect capabilities, ipc and small trusted computing bases through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: 保護域與可信邊界
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「保護域與可信邊界」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop protection domains and trust through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 微核心範圍：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「微核心範圍」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for microkernel scope.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「微核心範圍」的資料、控制與時間關係。最小核心將多數服務移到使用者域。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「畫核心與服務的邊界。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for microkernel scope. A minimal kernel moves many services to user domains. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw kernel/service boundaries. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 畫核心與服務的邊界。
steps.observationEn: Draw kernel/service boundaries.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：核心證明自動涵蓋所有驅動與應用。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Kernel proofs automatically cover all drivers and applications. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「微核心範圍」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「最小核心將多數服務移到使用者域。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit microkernel scope two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 微核心範圍的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 最小核心將多數服務移到使用者域。
knowledge.textEn: A minimal kernel moves many services to user domains.

knowledge.title: 微核心範圍的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 畫核心與服務的邊界。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Draw kernel/service boundaries. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設每次同步 IPC 往返消耗單核心 CPU 時間 2 µs（虛構），請求率 100,000/s，純 IPC CPU 時間佔一核心約 0.2 s/s=20%，未含服務工作與爭用。經過時間不必等於 CPU 時間。此假設不是 seL4 效能數據。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a fictional synchronous IPC round trip consumes 2 µs of single-core CPU time at 100,000 requests/s: IPC alone consumes 0.2 s/s, or 20% of one core, excluding service work and contention. Elapsed time need not equal CPU time; not seL4 performance data.

quiz.question: 本步審查「微核心範圍」與整體「微核心作業系統架構」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing microkernel scope within microkernel operating-system architecture, which statement or check is supported?
options: 最小核心將多數服務移到使用者域。
核心證明自動涵蓋所有驅動與應用。
使用者態驅動無需考慮 DMA 權限。
optionsEn: A minimal kernel moves many services to user domains.
Kernel proofs automatically cover all drivers and applications.
User-mode drivers need no DMA permission analysis.
quiz.explanation: 最小核心將多數服務移到使用者域。 畫核心與服務的邊界。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: A minimal kernel moves many services to user domains. Draw kernel/service boundaries. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 微核心範圍：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「畫核心與服務的邊界。」檢查「微核心範圍」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for microkernel scope using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「微核心範圍」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：畫核心與服務的邊界。 核對「最小核心將多數服務移到使用者域。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for microkernel scope and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Draw kernel/service boundaries. Check the principle: A minimal kernel moves many services to user domains. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 畫核心與服務的邊界。
steps.observationEn: Draw kernel/service boundaries.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：核心證明自動涵蓋所有驅動與應用。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Kernel proofs automatically cover all drivers and applications. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「微核心範圍」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「畫核心與服務的邊界。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit microkernel scope input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「同步 IPC」的資料、控制與時間關係。呼叫與接收配對會形成等待。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「檢查未有接收者的時序。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for synchronous ipc. Calls and receives pair and may wait. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Inspect timing without a receiver. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 檢查未有接收者的時序。
steps.observationEn: Inspect timing without a receiver.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：核心證明自動涵蓋所有驅動與應用。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Kernel proofs automatically cover all drivers and applications. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「同步 IPC」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「呼叫與接收配對會形成等待。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit synchronous ipc two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 同步 IPC的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 呼叫與接收配對會形成等待。
knowledge.textEn: Calls and receives pair and may wait.

knowledge.title: 同步 IPC的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 檢查未有接收者的時序。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Inspect timing without a receiver. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

quiz.question: 本步審查「同步 IPC」與整體「微核心作業系統架構」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing synchronous ipc within microkernel operating-system architecture, which statement or check is supported?
options: 呼叫與接收配對會形成等待。
核心證明自動涵蓋所有驅動與應用。
使用者態驅動無需考慮 DMA 權限。
optionsEn: Calls and receives pair and may wait.
Kernel proofs automatically cover all drivers and applications.
User-mode drivers need no DMA permission analysis.
quiz.explanation: 呼叫與接收配對會形成等待。 檢查未有接收者的時序。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Calls and receives pair and may wait. Inspect timing without a receiver. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 同步 IPC：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「檢查未有接收者的時序。」檢查「同步 IPC」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for synchronous ipc using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「同步 IPC」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：檢查未有接收者的時序。 核對「呼叫與接收配對會形成等待。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for synchronous ipc and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Inspect timing without a receiver. Check the principle: Calls and receives pair and may wait. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 檢查未有接收者的時序。
steps.observationEn: Inspect timing without a receiver.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：核心證明自動涵蓋所有驅動與應用。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Kernel proofs automatically cover all drivers and applications. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「同步 IPC」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「檢查未有接收者的時序。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit synchronous ipc input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、邊界與理想化前提；改變版本、工作負載、故障模型或資源條件後重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, boundaries and idealizations; recalculate after version, workload, fault-model or resource changes.

workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original assumed example; official sources support principles/context, not measurements of these numbers.

title: 裝置驅動程式工程
summary: 以裝置生命週期、DMA 與併發契約連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect device lifecycle, dma and concurrency contracts through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: 資源與探測
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「資源與探測」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop resources and probing through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 裝置匹配：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「裝置匹配」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for device matching.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「裝置匹配」的資料、控制與時間關係。匯流排識別與驅動匹配分開於功能探測。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對虛構裝置與驅動表。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for device matching. Bus matching differs from functional probing. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Match fictional devices and driver tables. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 核對虛構裝置與驅動表。
steps.observationEn: Match fictional devices and driver tables.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：DMA 位址可直接由 CPU 指標轉型得到。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: DMA addresses can be obtained by casting CPU pointers. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「裝置匹配」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「匯流排識別與驅動匹配分開於功能探測。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit device matching two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設 descriptor ring 有 256 格，每格 16 B，需 4096 B；每格代表一筆傳輸。在 1 M筆/s 且服務暫停 100 µs，積壓 100 格，未計既有佔用與突發，因此不能僅憑 256 格宣稱無損。
knowledge.textEn: A 256-entry descriptor ring at 16 B/entry uses 4096 B. At 1 Mitems/s, a 100 µs pause adds 100 entries; existing occupancy and bursts are excluded, so 256 entries do not establish losslessness.

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「探測失敗」的資料、控制與時間關係。部分成功後失敗需回收既有資源。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「在每個取得點插入假想失敗。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for probe failure. Partial probe failure needs resource rollback. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Insert modeled failures at acquisition points. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 在每個取得點插入假想失敗。
steps.observationEn: Insert modeled failures at acquisition points.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：DMA 位址可直接由 CPU 指標轉型得到。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: DMA addresses can be obtained by casting CPU pointers. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「探測失敗」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「部分成功後失敗需回收既有資源。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit probe failure two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 探測失敗的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 部分成功後失敗需回收既有資源。

knowledge.title: 探測失敗的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 在每個取得點插入假想失敗。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Insert modeled failures at acquisition points. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

quiz.question: 本步審查「探測失敗」與整體「裝置驅動程式工程」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing probe failure within device-driver engineering, which statement or check is supported?
options: DMA 位址可直接由 CPU 指標轉型得到。
部分成功後失敗需回收既有資源。
一致 DMA 保證所有 descriptor 更新順序。
optionsEn: DMA addresses can be obtained by casting CPU pointers.
Partial probe failure needs resource rollback.
Coherent DMA guarantees every descriptor update order.
quiz.explanation: 部分成功後失敗需回收既有資源。 在每個取得點插入假想失敗。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Partial probe failure needs resource rollback. Insert modeled failures at acquisition points. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 探測失敗：實驗與驗證

steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for probe failure and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Insert modeled failures at acquisition points. Check the principle: Partial probe failure needs resource rollback. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.

steps.check: 提交「探測失敗」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「在每個取得點插入假想失敗。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「卸載驗收」的資料、控制與時間關係。無功能錯誤不代表無資源洩漏。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對反覆取得與釋放計數。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for unload acceptance. Functional success does not imply no leaks. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. steps.observation: 核對反覆取得與釋放計數。

stages.title: SSA 與控制流

steps.title: 基本區塊：原理與架構

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for basic blocks. Blocks have entries and explicit terminators. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Split a toy program at branches. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

steps.observationEn: Split a toy program at branches.

Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.

steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「Undefined 邊界」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：明列除零與溢位語義。 核對「未定義語義不能用正常測例證明安全。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, boundaries and idealizations; recalculate after version, workload, fault-model or resource changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創算例；官方來源支援原理與背景，不是這組數字的實測來源。

title: 即時編譯與程式最佳化
summary: 以最佳化合法性、JIT 編譯與去最佳化連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect optimization legality, jit compilation and deoptimization through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: 執行時編譯契約
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「執行時編譯契約」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop runtime compilation contracts through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: JIT 與 AOT：原理與架構
steps.titleEn: JIT and AOT: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「JIT 與 AOT」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for jit and aot.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「JIT 與 AOT」的資料、控制與時間關係。編譯時間位置與可用資訊不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較啟動與穩態成本。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for jit and aot. Compilation timing and available information differ. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare startup and steady costs. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 比較啟動與穩態成本。
steps.observationEn: Compare startup and steady costs.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：測例相同就可忽略最佳化的副作用語義。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。

knowledge.title: JIT 與 AOT的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 比較啟動與穩態成本。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Compare startup and steady costs. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設編譯成本 40 ms，每次執行由 1.0 ms 降至 0.6 ms，節省 0.4 ms/call，回本次數=40/0.4=100 calls。未含暖機、profiling、記憶體及去最佳化；少於 100 次可能較慢。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 40 ms compilation and execution reduced from 1.0 to 0.6 ms/call. Break-even=40/0.4=100 calls, excluding warmup, profiling, memory and deoptimization; fewer calls may be slower.

options: 編譯時間位置與可用資訊不同。
測例相同就可忽略最佳化的副作用語義。
每個函式高成本最佳化必定降低總耗時。

Expensive optimization always reduces total time.

knowledge.textEn: Compare overlapping and disjoint arrays. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

quiz.question: 本步審查「向量化」與整體「即時編譯與程式最佳化」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing vectorization within just-in-time compilation and optimization, which statement or check is supported?
options: 測例相同就可忽略最佳化的副作用語義。
每個函式高成本最佳化必定降低總耗時。
資料相依與別名限制向量化合法性。
optionsEn: Matching tests permit ignoring side-effect semantics.
Expensive optimization always reduces total time.
Dependencies and aliasing limit legal vectorization.
quiz.explanation: 資料相依與別名限制向量化合法性。 比較重疊與不重疊陣列。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Dependencies and aliasing limit legal vectorization. Compare overlapping and disjoint arrays. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 向量化：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「比較重疊與不重疊陣列。」檢查「向量化」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for vectorization using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「向量化」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：比較重疊與不重疊陣列。 核對「資料相依與別名限制向量化合法性。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for vectorization and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Compare overlapping and disjoint arrays. Check the principle: Dependencies and aliasing limit legal vectorization. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 比較重疊與不重疊陣列。
steps.observationEn: Compare overlapping and disjoint arrays.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：每個函式高成本最佳化必定降低總耗時。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Expensive optimization always reduces total time. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「向量化」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較重疊與不重疊陣列。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit vectorization input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

stages.title: 程式碼生命週期
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「程式碼生命週期」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop code lifecycles through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 執行時守衛：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「執行時守衛」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for runtime guards.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「執行時守衛」的資料、控制與時間關係。特化假設需有可檢查條件。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「追蹤型別改變後路徑。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for runtime guards. Specialization assumptions need checkable guards. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Trace paths after a type change. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 追蹤型別改變後路徑。
steps.observationEn: Trace paths after a type change.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：測例相同就可忽略最佳化的副作用語義。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Matching tests permit ignoring side-effect semantics. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「執行時守衛」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「特化假設需有可檢查條件。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit runtime guards two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for lazy compilation using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「延遲編譯」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：比較首呼叫與穩態時間。 核對「首次呼叫成本需獨立計入。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for lazy compilation and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Compare first and steady calls. Check the principle: First-call compilation costs are separate. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 比較首呼叫與穩態時間。
steps.observationEn: Compare first and steady calls.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：測例相同就可忽略最佳化的副作用語義。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Matching tests permit ignoring side-effect semantics. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「延遲編譯」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較首呼叫與穩態時間。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit lazy compilation input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

knowledge.title: 延遲編譯的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 首次呼叫成本需獨立計入。
knowledge.textEn: First-call compilation costs are separate.

knowledge.title: 延遲編譯的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 比較首呼叫與穩態時間。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Compare first and steady calls. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

quiz.question: 本步審查「延遲編譯」與整體「即時編譯與程式最佳化」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing lazy compilation within just-in-time compilation and optimization, which statement or check is supported?
options: 比較首呼叫與穩態時間。
測例相同就可忽略最佳化的副作用語義。
每個函式高成本最佳化必定降低總耗時。
optionsEn: Compare first and steady calls.
Matching tests permit ignoring side-effect semantics.
Expensive optimization always reduces total time.
quiz.explanation: 首次呼叫成本需獨立計入。 比較首呼叫與穩態時間。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: First-call compilation costs are separate. Compare first and steady calls. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 程式碼回收：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「程式碼回收」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。

Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw reference and retirement lifetimes. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

steps.failure: 常見誤判：每個函式高成本最佳化必定降低總耗時。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Expensive optimization always reduces total time. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「程式碼回收」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「仍被使用的程式碼不能立即釋放。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit code reclamation two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. steps.title: 讀寫語義：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「列出追加與任意覆寫需求。」檢查「讀寫語義」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for read/write semantics using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「讀寫語義」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：列出追加與任意覆寫需求。 核對「分散檔案介面不必等同所有 POSIX 語義。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for read/write semantics and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: List append and random-overwrite needs. Check the principle: Distributed interfaces may differ from POSIX semantics. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 列出追加與任意覆寫需求。
steps.observationEn: List append and random-overwrite needs.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：抹除編碼省容量即代表修復沒有成本。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Erasure coding savings eliminate repair costs. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「讀寫語義」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「列出追加與任意覆寫需求。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit read/write semantics input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for replication factor. Replication affects capacity and fault tolerance. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Recalculate the three-replica capacity. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

steps.observation: 畫三副本的寫入確認。

knowledge.title: 還原演練的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 資料可讀與命名空間正確都需驗證。

knowledge.title: 還原演練的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 比對完整性、權限與路徑。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設資料 1 TiB，三份完整複本需要 3 TiB；6+3 抹除編碼的理想資料成本為 1.5 TiB。未含 metadata、padding、重建暫存與保留容量；編碼與複製的修復交通不同。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 1 TiB data: three replicas need 3 TiB, while ideal 6+3 erasure coding needs 1.5 TiB. Metadata, padding, rebuild scratch and headroom are omitted; repair traffic differs.

quiz.question: 本步審查「還原演練」與整體「分散式檔案系統」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？

抹除編碼省容量即代表修復沒有成本。

Compare integrity, permissions and paths.
Erasure coding savings eliminate repair costs.

quiz.explanationEn: Readable data and correct namespaces both matter. Compare integrity, permissions and paths. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, boundaries and idealizations; recalculate after version, workload, fault-model or resource changes.
