title: 物件儲存系統
summary: 以物件 API、版本與分佈式耐久性連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect object apis, versions and distributed durability through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: 物件與介面
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「物件與介面」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop objects and interfaces through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: Key 命名：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「Key 命名」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for key naming.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Key 命名」的資料、控制與時間關係。物件 key 不一定是真正的目錄。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較 prefix 與目錄移動需求。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for key naming. Object keys need not represent real directories. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare prefixes and directory-move needs. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 比較 prefix 與目錄移動需求。
steps.observationEn: Compare prefixes and directory-move needs.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：ETag 永遠就是內容 SHA-256。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: An ETag is always the content SHA-256. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「Key 命名」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「物件 key 不一定是真正的目錄。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit key naming two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設 100 TB 十進位資料以 8+3 編碼，理想成本=(11/8)×100=137.5 TB；保留 20% 總容量空閒需 137.5/0.8=171.875 TB。未含小物件 padding、metadata 與副本過渡。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 100 decimal TB with 8+3 coding: ideal storage=137.5 TB. Keeping 20% of total capacity free requires 171.875 TB. Small-object padding, metadata and transition copies are omitted.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設 100 TB 十進位資料以 8+3 編碼，理想成本=(11/8)×100=137.5 TB；保留 20% 總容量空閒需 137.5/0.8=171.875 TB。未含小物件 padding、metadata 與副本過渡。

ETag 永遠就是內容 SHA-256。
不同磁碟自然就有獨立故障概率。
optionsEn: Live object count cannot replace per-object digests.
An ETag is always the content SHA-256.
Different disks automatically have independent failures.
quiz.explanation: 存活物件數不能替代逐物件摘要。 比較修復前後版本與摘要。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Live object count cannot replace per-object digests. Compare versions and digests across repair. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 修復驗收：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「比較修復前後版本與摘要。」檢查「修復驗收」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for repair acceptance using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「修復驗收」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：比較修復前後版本與摘要。 核對「存活物件數不能替代逐物件摘要。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for repair acceptance and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Compare versions and digests across repair. Check the principle: Live object count cannot replace per-object digests. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 比較修復前後版本與摘要。
steps.observationEn: Compare versions and digests across repair.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：不同磁碟自然就有獨立故障概率。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Different disks automatically have independent failures. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「修復驗收」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較修復前後版本與摘要。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit repair acceptance input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設 100 TB 十進位資料以 8+3 編碼，理想成本=(11/8)×100=137.5 TB；保留 20% 總容量空閒需 137.5/0.8=171.875 TB。未含小物件 padding、metadata 與副本過渡。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 100 decimal TB with 8+3 coding: ideal storage=137.5 TB. Keeping 20% of total capacity free requires 171.875 TB. Small-object padding, metadata and transition copies are omitted.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

workedExample.title: 原創可重算假想案例

workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、邊界與理想化前提；改變版本、工作負載、故障模型或資源條件後重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, boundaries and idealizations; recalculate after version, workload, fault-model or resource changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創算例；官方來源支援原理與背景，不是這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original assumed example; official sources support principles/context, not measurements of these numbers.

title: 資料庫交易與日誌
summary: 以ACID、MVCC 與可復原日誌連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect acid, mvcc and recoverable logging through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: 交易與隔離
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「交易與隔離」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop transactions and isolation through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: ACID 分離：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「ACID 分離」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for acid separation.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「ACID 分離」的資料、控制與時間關係。原子性、一致性、隔離與耐久是不同屬性。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「將假想失敗對應各屬性。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for acid separation. Atomicity, consistency, isolation and durability differ. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Map fictional failures to properties. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 將假想失敗對應各屬性。
steps.observationEn: Map fictional failures to properties.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：MVCC 等於所有交易均為 serializable。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: MVCC makes every transaction serializable. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「ACID 分離」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「原子性、一致性、隔離與耐久是不同屬性。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit acid separation two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設每批 fsync=4 ms 且一次序列寫入，單筆提交理想上界 250 commits/s；每批 20 交易的 group commit 為 5000 transactions/s，上界未含日誌流量、鎖與排隊延遲。
knowledge.textEn: With assumed 4 ms serial fsync, one transaction/batch has an ideal 250 commits/s bound. Twenty transactions/group yields 5000 transactions/s, excluding log bandwidth, locks and queueing.

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「讀取快照」的資料、控制與時間關係。可見版本取決於交易隔離規則。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「追蹤兩交易讀到的值。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for read snapshots. Visible versions follow isolation rules. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Trace values observed by two transactions. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 追蹤兩交易讀到的值。
steps.observationEn: Trace values observed by two transactions.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：MVCC 等於所有交易均為 serializable。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: MVCC makes every transaction serializable. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「讀取快照」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「可見版本取決於交易隔離規則。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit read snapshots two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 讀取快照的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 可見版本取決於交易隔離規則。
knowledge.textEn: Visible versions follow isolation rules.

knowledge.title: 讀取快照的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 追蹤兩交易讀到的值。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Trace values observed by two transactions. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

quiz.question: 本步審查「讀取快照」與整體「資料庫交易與日誌」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing read snapshots within database transactions and logging, which statement or check is supported?
options: MVCC 等於所有交易均為 serializable。
可見版本取決於交易隔離規則。
資料頁先耐久而日誌後寫仍符合 WAL。
optionsEn: MVCC makes every transaction serializable.
Visible versions follow isolation rules.
Durable pages before their logs satisfy WAL.
quiz.explanation: 可見版本取決於交易隔離規則。 追蹤兩交易讀到的值。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Visible versions follow isolation rules. Trace values observed by two transactions. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 讀取快照：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「追蹤兩交易讀到的值。」檢查「讀取快照」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for read snapshots using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「讀取快照」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：追蹤兩交易讀到的值。 核對「可見版本取決於交易隔離規則。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for read snapshots and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Trace values observed by two transactions. Check the principle: Visible versions follow isolation rules. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 追蹤兩交易讀到的值。
steps.observationEn: Trace values observed by two transactions.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：MVCC 等於所有交易均為 serializable。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: MVCC makes every transaction serializable. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「讀取快照」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「追蹤兩交易讀到的值。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit read snapshots input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

資料頁先耐久而日誌後寫仍符合 WAL。
比較長快照與清理積壓。
optionsEn: MVCC makes every transaction serializable.
Durable pages before their logs satisfy WAL.
Compare long snapshots and cleanup backlog.
quiz.explanation: 長交易可能阻止舊版本回收。 比較長快照與清理積壓。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Long transactions can delay version reclamation. Compare long snapshots and cleanup backlog. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 不變量驗收：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「不變量驗收」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for invariant acceptance.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「不變量驗收」的資料、控制與時間關係。資料庫提交不代表業務不變量正確。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對餘額守恆與唯一約束。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for invariant acceptance. Commit success does not establish business invariants. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check balance conservation and uniqueness. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 核對餘額守恆與唯一約束。
steps.observationEn: Check balance conservation and uniqueness.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：資料頁先耐久而日誌後寫仍符合 WAL。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Durable pages before their logs satisfy WAL. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「不變量驗收」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「資料庫提交不代表業務不變量正確。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit invariant acceptance two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 不變量驗收的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 資料庫提交不代表業務不變量正確。
knowledge.textEn: Commit success does not establish business invariants.

knowledge.title: 不變量驗收的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 核對餘額守恆與唯一約束。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Check balance conservation and uniqueness. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設每批 fsync=4 ms 且一次序列寫入，單筆提交理想上界 250 commits/s；每批 20 交易的 group commit 為 5000 transactions/s，上界未含日誌流量、鎖與排隊延遲。
knowledge.textEn: With assumed 4 ms serial fsync, one transaction/batch has an ideal 250 commits/s bound. Twenty transactions/group yields 5000 transactions/s, excluding log bandwidth, locks and queueing.

options: 資料庫提交不代表業務不變量正確。

quiz.explanationEn: Commit success does not establish business invariants. Check balance conservation and uniqueness. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 不變量驗收：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「核對餘額守恆與唯一約束。」檢查「不變量驗收」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for invariant acceptance using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「不變量驗收」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：核對餘額守恆與唯一約束。 核對「資料庫提交不代表業務不變量正確。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for invariant acceptance and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Check balance conservation and uniqueness. Check the principle: Commit success does not establish business invariants. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 核對餘額守恆與唯一約束。
steps.observationEn: Check balance conservation and uniqueness.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：資料頁先耐久而日誌後寫仍符合 WAL。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Durable pages before their logs satisfy WAL. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「不變量驗收」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「核對餘額守恆與唯一約束。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit invariant acceptance input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

workedExample.title: 原創可重算假想案例
workedExample.text: 假設每批 fsync=4 ms 且一次序列寫入，單筆提交理想上界 250 commits/s；每批 20 交易的 group commit 為 5000 transactions/s，上界未含日誌流量、鎖與排隊延遲。

workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、邊界與理想化前提；改變版本、工作負載、故障模型或資源條件後重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, boundaries and idealizations; recalculate after version, workload, fault-model or resource changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創算例；官方來源支援原理與背景，不是這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original assumed example; official sources support principles/context, not measurements of these numbers.
